questlog.quest_10.mission_1.name: Mission 01: Something Rotten
questlog.quest_10.mission_1.state_1: Palimuth vous a demandé de l'aider à résoudre certains dysfonctionnements des égouts. Vous aurez besoin d'un pied de biche, il y a 4 endroits où vous devez vous rendre marqués d'un X sur votre carte.

questlog.quest_10.mission_1.state_5: Vous avez nettoyé 4 tuyaux sur 4 des ordures. Retournez à Palimuth et rapportez votre mission
questlog.quest_10.mission_1.state_6: Vous avez nettoyé tous les tuyaux des poubelles ! Retournez à Palimuth et demandez une mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_10.name: Mission 10: The Final Battle
questlog.quest_10.mission_10.state_1: Palimuth vous a dit qu'un cercle de Yalahari préparait une sorte de rituel. Ils prévoient de créer un portail pour de puissants démons et de les libérer dans la ville pour le 'purge' une fois pour toutes.
questlog.quest_10.mission_10.state_2: L’entrée de leur sanctuaire intérieur vous a été ouverte. Préparez-vous pour une bataille DIFFICILE ! Mieux vaut rassembler des amis pour vous aider.
questlog.quest_10.mission_10.state_3: Faites votre rapport au directeur que vous avez choisi d'aider et vous recevrez des tenues Yalaharian.
questlog.quest_10.mission_10.state_4: Vous avez accès à la salle des récompenses. Choisissez soigneusement la récompense que vous choisissez car vous ne pouvez prendre qu'un seul objet.
questlog.quest_10.mission_2.name: Mission 02: Watching the Watchmen
questlog.quest_10.mission_2.state_1: Vous devez trouver les 7 gardes et leur faire un rapport. Vous devez commencer par Quartier Étranger ou par Quartier Commercial et suivre l'ordre du chemin.
questlog.quest_10.mission_2.state_2: Vous vous êtes présenté à l'un des sept gardes
questlog.quest_10.mission_2.state_3: Vous avez signalé à 2 des 7 gardes
questlog.quest_10.mission_2.state_4: Vous avez fait rapport à 3 gardes sur 7
questlog.quest_10.mission_2.state_5: Vous avez fait rapport à 4 gardes sur 7
questlog.quest_10.mission_2.state_6: Vous avez signalé à 5 des 7 gardes
questlog.quest_10.mission_2.state_7: Vous avez signalé à 6 des 7 gardes
questlog.quest_10.mission_2.state_8: Vous avez fait rapport à 7 gardes sur 7 ! Retournez à Palimuth et demandez une mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_3.name: Mission 03: Death to the Deathbringer
questlog.quest_10.mission_3.state_1: Récupérez les notes dans la chambre de Palimuth et lisez-les. Parlez à nouveau à Palimuth lorsque vous avez lu les notes.
questlog.quest_10.mission_3.state_2: Parlez à Azerus le Yalahari dans le centre-ville pour obtenir votre prochaine mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_3.state_3: Obtenez les notes derrière le Yalahari et lisez-les. Parlez à nouveau à Azerus et demandez-lui une mission lorsque vous aurez lu les notes.
questlog.quest_10.mission_3.state_5: Vous devrez d'abord tuer les trois porteurs de la peste, puis obtenir les formules des alchimistes. Lorsque cela a été fait, retournez soit à Palimuth (bon côté), soit à Yalahari (Azerus) (mauvais côté).
questlog.quest_10.mission_3.state_6: Demandez une mission à Azerus les Yalahari.
questlog.quest_10.mission_4.name: Mission 04: Good to be Kingpin
questlog.quest_10.mission_4.state_2: Pour cette mission, vous êtes invité à vous rendre au Quartier Commercial et à négocier ou menacer M. West. Une fois de plus, vous aurez accès au mécanisme, mais si vous choisissez d'aider Palimuth, vous devrez passer par les égouts.
questlog.quest_10.mission_4.state_3: Vous avez décidé d'aider Palimuth, rapportez-lui votre mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_4.state_4: Vous avez décidé d'aider Azerus, signalez-lui votre mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_4.state_5: Retournez voir Azerus et rapportez-lui votre mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_5.name: Mission 05: Food or Fight
questlog.quest_10.mission_5.state_2: Lors de cette mission, il vous est demandé de trouver un druide du nom de Tamerin, dans le Quartier de l'Arène. Vous avez maintenant la permission d'utiliser le mécanisme des portes.
questlog.quest_10.mission_5.state_3: La première consiste à apporter à Tamerin un flacon de Cure Animale, vous pouvez l'acheter auprès de Siflind sur Nibelor (au nord-est de Svargrond).
questlog.quest_10.mission_5.state_4: vous devez maintenant tuer Morik le gladiateur et apporter son casque à Tamerin comme preuve.
questlog.quest_10.mission_5.state_5: Faites votre rapport à Tamerin car il écoutera votre demande et vous pourrez maintenant faire votre choix : du bétail pour Palimuth (bon côté), des bêtes de guerre pour Yalahari (Azerus) (mauvais côté). Signalez ensuite celui à qui vous avez décidé de votre mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_5.state_6: Vous avez décidé d'aider Palimuth, rapportez-lui votre mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_5.state_7: Vous avez décidé d'aider Azerus, signalez-lui votre mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_6.name: Mission 06: Frightening Fuel
questlog.quest_10.mission_6.state_2: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
questlog.quest_10.mission_6.state_3: Bon côté : allez voir Palimuth, interrogez-le sur votre mission et remettez le charme. Mauvais côté : Renseignez-vous sur votre mission à Yalahari (Azerus) et rendez-la.
questlog.quest_10.mission_6.state_4: Retournez voir Azerus et rapportez-lui votre mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_7.name: Mission 07: A Fishy Mission
questlog.quest_10.mission_7.state_2: Mauvais côté : Yalahari (Azerus) vous enverra pour une nouvelle mission : vous rendre dans le Quartier Englouti et tuer les leaders Quara, Inky, Splasher et Sharptooth. Bon côté : Plutôt que de combattre les dirigeants Quara, Palimuth vous enverra plutôt trouver la cause du comportement agressif de Quaras. Trouvez Maritima et parlez-lui des Quara et elle vous expliquera quel est leur problème.
questlog.quest_10.mission_7.state_3: Retournez à Palimuth et rapportez-lui votre mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_7.state_4: Vous avez tué les Quaraboss. Demandez à Azerus une mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_8.name: Mission 08: Dangerous Machinations
questlog.quest_10.mission_8.state_2: Mauvais côté : Pour cette mission, le Yalahari vous demande d'aller au Quartier des Usines et de trouver un cristal à motif, qui servira à fournir des armes pour aider à prendre le contrôle de la ville. Bon côté : Palimuth vous enverra là-bas pour utiliser le cristal pour approvisionner la ville en nourriture.
questlog.quest_10.mission_8.state_3: Retournez voir Azerus et rapportez-lui votre mission.
questlog.quest_10.mission_9.name: Mission 09: Decision
questlog.quest_10.mission_9.state_1: Vous devez maintenant choisir entre soutenir Palimuth ou l'objectif des Yalahari. Pour choisir le bon côté de Palimuth, allez vers lui, et demandez-lui simplement une mission. De même, pour rejoindre le Yalahari (Azerus) (mauvais côté), allez vers lui et dites la même chose.

questlog.quest_12.mission_4.state_1: Bron told you that his brother Ajax in Northport needs to learn that violence is not always the answer. He told you to make his brother angry, then show him that all he needed to do was say 'please' to fix the situation.

questlog.quest_12.mission_4.state_11: You got the Barbarian Wig Addon! Bring now the present from Bron to Ajax!

questlog.quest_14.mission_1.name: Mission 1: The Plans
questlog.quest_14.mission_1.state_1: Spectulus in Edron has sent you on a mission to find out the whereabouts of a certain inventor. A beggar in Edron seems to know more about this topic than he wants to tell.
questlog.quest_14.mission_1.state_2: The beggar turned out to be the inventor himself. You successfully convinced him to give you the only remaining plans of his creation. You should return to Spectulus in Edron to tell him the news.
questlog.quest_14.mission_1.state_3: You gave the plans to the astronomer. He began reconstructing the invention as soon as he got ahold of them. It will take a while for him to work out the problem which caused the initial failure.
questlog.quest_14.mission_1.state_4: You returned to Speculus who finally worked out the failure of the initial construction. He recapitulated the plans and needs only one item before he can start building the magic device.
questlog.quest_14.mission_2.name: Mission 2: The Collector
questlog.quest_14.mission_2.state_1: Spectulus asked you to enter the Lost Mines beneath Edron and recover a rare crystal. In exchange for it you will gain access to the lair of the Collector who guards a vital component of the device.
questlog.quest_14.mission_2.state_2: Luckily, you survived the horrors of the Lost Mines and recovered a rare crystal. You should visit Spectulus in Edron to seek counsel on what to do next.
questlog.quest_14.mission_2.state_3: You returned to astronomer Spectulus and gave him the rare crystal.
questlog.quest_14.mission_3.name: Mission 3: The Mirror Crystal
questlog.quest_14.mission_3.state_1: In order to access the lair of the Collector, you will need to find the creature's well on an ice isle near Carlin. To donate the rare crystal overcome your greed and use it at the well's pedestal.
questlog.quest_14.mission_3.state_2: You offered the rare crystal to the creature and can now enter the Collector's lair. Its crystal chamber cannot be accessed by outsiders. You need to find a way to snatch the Mirror Crystal.
questlog.quest_14.mission_3.state_3: The Collector has been defeated. You packed the fragile Mirror Crystal into the device Spectulus gave you. All yo have to do now is to return to the astronomer and to present him your acquisition.
questlog.quest_14.mission_3.state_4: It may have been the excitement or simple nervousness but as soon as Spectulus removed the crystal, it somehow slipped. Unfinishable for all eternity, the device left yet another scholar in despair.
questlog.quest_14.name: Sea of Light
questlog.quest_15.mission_1.name: Mission 1: From Thais with Love
questlog.quest_15.mission_1.state_1: Your first mission is to deliver a warning to the Venoreans. Get a fire bug from Liberty Bay and set their shipyard on fire.
questlog.quest_15.mission_1.state_2: You have set the Venoreans shipyard on fire, report back to Chester!
questlog.quest_15.mission_1.state_3: You have reported back that you have completed your mission, ask Chester for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_10.name: Mission 4: Objective Hellgate
questlog.quest_15.mission_10.state_1: Your next mission is to investigate for some documents in Hellgate.
questlog.quest_15.mission_10.state_2: You have delivered the documents to Chester, ask him for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_11.name: Mission 4: Pawn Captures Knight
questlog.quest_15.mission_11.state_1: Your next task is to travel to the Black Knight's Villa and kill the Black Knight!
questlog.quest_15.mission_11.state_2: You have killed the Black Knight, report back to Uncle!
questlog.quest_15.mission_11.state_3: You have reported back that you have completed your task, ask Uncle for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_12.name: Mission 4: Plot for A Plan
questlog.quest_15.mission_12.state_1: Emma has requested that you retrieve the Building Plans for a ship from the Venore shipyard.
questlog.quest_15.mission_12.state_2: You have delivered the Building Plans to Emma, ask her for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_13.name: Mission 5: Coldfinger
questlog.quest_15.mission_13.state_1: Your next mission is to travel to the southern barbarians camp and place false evidence!
questlog.quest_15.mission_13.state_2: You have placed the false evidence! Report back to Chester.
questlog.quest_15.mission_13.state_3: You have reported back that you have completed your mission, ask Chester for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_14.name: Mission 5: A Cryptic Mission
questlog.quest_15.mission_14.state_1: Your next task is to travel to the Isle of the Kings and find a ring.
questlog.quest_15.mission_14.state_2: You have delivered the ring to Uncle, ask him for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_15.name: Mission 5: No Admittance
questlog.quest_15.mission_15.state_1: Emma has requested that you find some hints in the ruins of Dark Cathedral.
questlog.quest_15.mission_15.state_2: You have delivered the Suspicious Documents to Emma, ask her for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_16.name: Mission 6: The Weakest Spot
questlog.quest_15.mission_16.state_1: Your next mission is to disguise yourself as an amazon and destroy a beer casket in the north-east corner in the cellar of Svargrond's Tavern.
questlog.quest_15.mission_16.state_2: You have succesfully destroyed the beer casket disguised as an amazon, report back to Chester!
questlog.quest_15.mission_16.state_3: You have reported back that you have completed your mission, ask Chester for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_17.name: Mission 6: A Little Bribe Won't Hurt
questlog.quest_15.mission_17.state_1: Your next task is to bribe a barbarian in the large barbarian camp with a weapons crate.
questlog.quest_15.mission_17.state_2: You have bribed Freezhild with the weapons create! Report back to Uncle.
questlog.quest_15.mission_17.state_3: You have reported back that you have completed your task, ask Uncle for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_18.name: Mission 6: News From the Past
questlog.quest_15.mission_18.state_1: Emma has requested that you go to the Isle of the Kings and retrieve a book.
questlog.quest_15.mission_18.state_2: You have delivered the book to Emma, ask her for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_19.name: Mission 7: Licence to Kill
questlog.quest_15.mission_19.state_1: A Mad Technomancer in Kazordoon is trying to blackmail the city! Kill him and bring back his beard as proof.
questlog.quest_15.mission_19.state_2: You have reported back that you have completed your mission, you are now a Special Agent!
questlog.quest_15.mission_2.name: Mission 1: For Your Eyes Only
questlog.quest_15.mission_2.state_1: Your first task is to deliver a letter to Gamel in thais, If he is a bit reluctant, be persuasive.
questlog.quest_15.mission_2.state_2: Gamel sent his thugs on you, defeat them and deliver the letter to Gamel!
questlog.quest_15.mission_2.state_3: After defeating Gamel's thugs, he found you to be persuasive enough to accept the letter. Report back to Uncle!
questlog.quest_15.mission_2.state_4: You have reported back that you have completed your task. Ask Uncle for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_3.name: Mission 1: Borrowed Knowledge
questlog.quest_15.mission_3.state_1: Emma has requested that you steal a Nature Magic Spellbook in the Edron academy.
questlog.quest_15.mission_3.state_2: You have delivered the Nature Magic Spellbook to Emma, ask her for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_4.name: Mission 2: Operation Green Claw
questlog.quest_15.mission_4.state_1: Your next mission is to find some information about one of their missing agents in The Green Claw Swamp.
questlog.quest_15.mission_4.state_2: You have delivered the Black Knight's notes to Chester, ask him for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_5.name: Mission 2: A File Between Friends
questlog.quest_15.mission_5.state_1: Your next task is to retrieve a file named AH-X17L89.
questlog.quest_15.mission_5.state_2: You have delivered the file named AH-X17L89 to Uncle, ask him for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_6.name: Mission 2: Codename:Lumberjack
questlog.quest_15.mission_6.state_1: Emma has requested that you retrieve a Rotten Heart of a Tree from the Black Knight Villa in Greenclaw swamp north-west of Venore.
questlog.quest_15.mission_6.state_2: You have delivered the Rotten Heart of a Tree to Emma, ask her for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_7.name: Mission 3: Treachery in Port Hope
questlog.quest_15.mission_7.state_1: Your next mission is to retrieve some evidence that the traders in Port Hope are up to no good!
questlog.quest_15.mission_7.state_2: You have found the evidence, report back to Chester!
questlog.quest_15.mission_7.state_3: You have reported back that you have completed your mission, ask Chester for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_8.name: Mission 3: What Men are Made of
questlog.quest_15.mission_8.state_1: Your next task is to bring a barrel of beer to the Secret Tavern in the sewers of Carlin.
questlog.quest_15.mission_8.state_2: On your way to the Secret Tavern in the sewers you were attacked by amazons trying to stop you! Deliver the barrel of beer to Karl.
questlog.quest_15.mission_8.state_3: You have delivered the barrel of beer to Karl, report back to Uncle!
questlog.quest_15.mission_8.state_4: You have reported back that you have completed your task, ask Uncle for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.mission_9.name: Mission 3: Rust in Peace
questlog.quest_15.mission_9.state_1: Emma has requested that you damage the Ironhouse of Venore, use the Case of Rust Bugs on the keyhole in the cellar of the ironhouse.
questlog.quest_15.mission_9.state_2: The bugs are at work! Report back to Emma.
questlog.quest_15.mission_9.state_3: You have reported back that you have completed your mission, ask her for a new mission!
questlog.quest_15.name: Secret Service
questlog.quest_16.mission_1.name: Omruc's Treasure
questlog.quest_16.mission_1.state_1: Now you can start the steps until you reach Omruc's room.
questlog.quest_16.mission_1.state_2: You defeated Omruc and received a helmet adornment.
questlog.quest_16.mission_2.name: Thalas' Treasure
questlog.quest_16.mission_2.state_1: Congratulations, you have pulled all 8 levers and can now continue to the next step.
questlog.quest_16.mission_2.state_2: You defeated Thalas and received a Gem Holder
questlog.quest_16.mission_3.name: Diphtrah's Treasure
questlog.quest_16.mission_3.state_1: Now you need to pull all 11 levers to be able to continue.
questlog.quest_16.mission_3.state_2: Now you need to use all the plaques before accessing Diphtrah's room.
questlog.quest_16.mission_3.state_3: Congratulations, this step has been completed.
questlog.quest_16.mission_4.name: Mahrdis' Treasure
questlog.quest_16.mission_4.state_1: You need to defeat Mahrdis and receive a Helmet Ornament.
questlog.quest_16.mission_4.state_2: You defeated Mahrdis and received a Helmet Ornament.
questlog.quest_16.mission_5.name: Vashresamun's Treasure
questlog.quest_16.mission_5.state_1: Once you've started this quest, you'll need to play the musicals before teleporting.
questlog.quest_16.mission_5.state_2: Congratulations, you played the musical correctly, now you can continue.
questlog.quest_16.mission_5.state_3: You solved the musical riddles of Vashresamun's Tomb and received a left horn.
questlog.quest_16.mission_6.name: Morguthis' Treasure
questlog.quest_16.mission_6.state_1: Now you need to go over the blue fireworks on the path.
questlog.quest_16.mission_6.state_2: You defeated Morguthis and received a Right Horn.
questlog.quest_16.mission_7.name: Rahemos' Treasure
questlog.quest_16.mission_7.state_1: You have started the steps to access Rahemos' room, and you will need to pull some levers to get to Rahemos' room.
questlog.quest_16.mission_7.state_2: You defeated Rahemos and received a Helmet Piece.
questlog.quest_16.name: The Ancient Tombs
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.name: Hairycles' Missions
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_1: Find whisper moss in the dworc settlement south of Port Hope and bring it back to Hairycles.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_10: You have completed the fifth mission. Hairycles attempts to create a might charm for the protection of the ape people. He might have another mission for you later.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_11: Hairycles need a witches' cap mushroom which is supposed to be hidden in a dungeon deep under Fibula.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_12: You have completed the sixth mission. You brought the witches' cap mushroom back to Hairycles. He might have another mission for you.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_13: Hairycles is worried about an ape cult which drinks some strange fluid that the lizards left behind. Go to the old lizard temple under Banuta and destroy three of the casks there with a crowbar.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_14: You have completed the seventh mission. You found the old lizard ruins under Banuta and destroyed three of the casks with snake blood. Hairycles might have another mission for you.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_15: The apes now need a symbol of their faith. Speak with the blind prophet in a cave to the northeast and go to the Forbidden Land. Find a hair of the giant, holy ape Bong and bring it back.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_16: You completed the eighth mission. Hairycles gladly accepted the hair of the ape god which you brought him. He told you to have one final mission for you.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_17: Go into the deepest catacombs under Banuta and destroy the monument of the snake god with the hammer that Hairycles gave to you.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_18: You successfully destroyed the monument of the snake god. As reward, you can buy sacred statues from Hairycles. If you haven't done so yet, you should also ask him for a shaman outfit.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_2: You have completed the first mission. Hairycles was happy about the whisper moss you gave to him. He might have another mission for you.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_3: Hairycles asked you to bring him cough syrup from a human settlement. A healer might know more about this medicine.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_4: You have completed the second mission. Hairycles was happy about the cough syrup you gave to him. He might have another mission for you.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_5: Hairycles asked you to bring him a magical scroll from the lizard settlement Chor.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_6: You have completed the third mission. Hairycles appreciated that you brought the scroll to him and will try to read it. Maybe he has another mission for you later.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_7: Since Hairycles was not able to read the scroll you brought him, he asked you dig for a tomb in the desert to the east. Proceed in this tomb until you find an obelisk between red stones and read it.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_8: You have completed the fourth mission. Hairycles read your mind and can now translate the lizard scroll. He might have another mission for you.
questlog.quest_17.mission_1.state_9: Hairycles wants to create a life charm for the ape people. He needs a hydra egg since it has strong regenerating powers.
questlog.quest_17.name: The Ape City
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.name: The Cockroach Plague
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_1: You have found a fisherman called Santiago, who has a little problem. Maybe you should talk to him again to find out more.
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_10: Santiago asked you if you had seen Zirella. Don't let him wait for the answer.
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_11: You have helped Santiago a lot by killing the cokcroaches in his cellar. In exchange, he gave you equipment and some valuable experience. Well done!
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_2: Santiago asked you to go into his house. Upstairs you will find a chest. You can keep what you find inside of it. Once you got that, talk to Santiago again.
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_3: You have found Santiago's Coat and reported back to him. Your quest is not done yet, you should talk to him a bit more.
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_4: Santiago gave you a weapon. After equipping it, go to the cellar of his house to find out about the cockroach plague.
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_5: You brought the cockroach legs to Santiago. He still has something to tell you though.
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_6: Santiago asked you, if those cockroaches hurt you. You should reply to him!
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_7: Santiago has a valuable lesson for you. You should talk to him again.
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_8: Santiago showed you how some monsters might hurt you. Better to talk to him to learn a way to heal yourself.
questlog.quest_18.mission_1.state_9: Santiago gave you some fish! Just 'use' it to eat it and regain health. Afterwards, you should talk to Santiago again.
questlog.quest_18.mission_2.name: Collecting Wood
questlog.quest_18.mission_2.state_1: You have a vague idea that Zirella might need you for collecting firewood, but you don't know yet where to get it. You should talk to her again.
questlog.quest_18.mission_2.state_2: You know that the branches Zirella needs might be gotten from dead trees in the forest south of here, but you don't know the details yet. You should talk to her but there is some information missing. You should talk to Zirella again.
questlog.quest_18.mission_2.state_4: You have learned that you can push the branch which you've broken from a dead tree by 'Drag & Drop', but you still need some information. You should talk to Zirella again.
questlog.quest_18.mission_2.state_5: You know that you have to 'Use' the branch. Then leftclick with the changed cursor on the cart. Now you just have to tell Zirella that you will help her.
questlog.quest_18.mission_2.state_6: Go into the forest south of here and look for trees without leaves. 'Use' one to break a branch from it, then drag & drop the branch back to her cart and 'Use' it with the cart.
questlog.quest_18.mission_2.state_7: You have brought a branch to Zirella, congratulations! You should talk to her again for your reward.
questlog.quest_18.mission_2.state_8: You have helped Zirella by collecting wood for her. The reward can be found in her house.
questlog.quest_18.mission_3.name: A Hungry Tailor
questlog.quest_18.mission_3.state_1: You found another person named Carlos. You should talk to him learn how to change your outfit.
questlog.quest_18.mission_3.state_2: Carlos taught you how to change your outfit. Now he seems to be wanting a small favour from you. Talk to him again to learn more.
questlog.quest_18.mission_3.state_3: Carlos asked you whether you could bring him some food. Talk to him again to learn how to find food here.
questlog.quest_18.mission_3.state_4: Carlos asked you to hunt some deer and rabbits and loot them to find a piece of ham or meat. However you haven't agreed yet, so you should tell him that you'll do it.
questlog.quest_18.mission_3.state_5: You agreed to bring Carlos some food. Hunt some deer or rabbit until you find a piece of meat or ham talk to Carlos again.
questlog.quest_18.mission_3.state_6: To sell the meat or ham to Carlos, talk to him and ask him for a 'trade'.
questlog.quest_18.mission_3.state_7: You sucessfully learnt how to change your outfit and how to trade with NPCs. Time to head over the bridge to Rookgaard!
questlog.quest_18.mission_3.state_8: You have passed the bridge to Rookgaard and have sucessfully completed the Tutorial. If you want to skip the tutorial in the future with a new character, simply say 'skip tutorial' to Santiago.
questlog.quest_18.name: The Beginning
questlog.quest_19.mission_1.name: Efreet Mission 1: The Supply Thief
questlog.quest_19.mission_1.state_1: Travel to Thais and keep your eyes open for something that might give you a clue on the supply thief.
questlog.quest_19.mission_1.state_2: You have found the potential supply thief - Partos in Thais seemed very suspicious. Baa'leal might be interested in this matter.
questlog.quest_19.mission_1.state_3: You have reported the case to Baa'leal. He seemed very satisfied and told you that Alesar might have another mission for you.
questlog.quest_19.mission_2.name: Efreet Mission 2: The Tear of Daraman
questlog.quest_19.mission_2.state_1: Sneak into Ashta'daramai and steal a "Tear of Daraman". For more information about these gems visit the Efreet library.
questlog.quest_19.mission_2.state_2: You have successfully managed to steal a Tear of Daraman from Ashta'daramai. Bring it to Alesar.
questlog.quest_19.mission_2.state_3: You have delivered Daraman's Tear. Alesar seemed very satisfied and told you that Malor himself might have another mission for you.
questlog.quest_19.mission_3.name: Efreet Mission 3: The Sleeping Lamp
questlog.quest_19.mission_3.state_1: Malor asked you to find Fa'hradin's sleeping lamp in the orc fortress at Ulderek's Rock. Then, sneak into Ashta'daramai and exchange Gabel's sleeping lamp with Fa'hradin's lamp.
questlog.quest_19.mission_3.state_2: You successfully exchanged the lamps. Malor will be happy to hear about this.
questlog.quest_19.mission_3.state_3: The Efreet are very satisfied with your help. King Malor allowed you to trade with Yaman and Alesar.
questlog.quest_19.name: The Djinn War - Efreet Faction
questlog.quest_2.mission_1.name: The Feared Hugo
questlog.quest_2.mission_1.state_1: Oldrak told you that the fearsome Hugo was accidentally created by the mage Yenny the Gentle. Try to find out more about this.
questlog.quest_2.mission_1.state_2: Zoltan told you about Crunor's Caress, a druid order originating from Carlin. Try to find out more about this.
questlog.quest_2.mission_1.state_3: Padreia told you that Crunor's Caress founded the inn Crunor's Cottage south of Mt. Sternum. Try to find out more about this.
questlog.quest_2.mission_1.state_4: Lubo told you about a magical experiment that went wrong and created a demonbunny. Someone might be interested in this...
questlog.quest_2.mission_2.name: Favorite colour: Green
questlog.quest_2.mission_3.name: The Secret of Mathemagics
questlog.quest_2.mission_3.state_1: You learnt Mathemagics. Everything is based on the simple fact that 1+1=1.
questlog.quest_2.mission_3.state_2: You learnt Mathemagics. Everything is based on the simple fact that 1+1=1.
questlog.quest_2.name: The Paradox Tower
questlog.quest_20.mission_1.name: Marid Mission 1: The Dwarven Kitchen
questlog.quest_20.mission_1.state_1: Bring a cookbook of the dwarven kitchen to Bo'ques.
questlog.quest_20.mission_1.state_2: You have delivered the cookbook. Bo'ques seemed very satisfied and told you that Fa'hradin might have another mission for you.
questlog.quest_20.mission_2.name: Marid Mission 2: The Spyreport
questlog.quest_20.mission_2.state_1: Fa'hradin asked you to sneak into the Efreet fortress Mal'ouqhah and find their undercover spy. The codeword is PIEDPIPER.
questlog.quest_20.mission_2.state_2: You have delivered the spyreport. Fa'hradin seemed impressed and told you that Gabel himself might have another mission for you.
questlog.quest_20.mission_3.name: Rata'Mari and the Cheese
questlog.quest_20.mission_3.state_1: You have promised Rata'Mari cheese. Once you deliver some to him, he will hand over his spyreport.
questlog.quest_20.mission_3.state_2: You got Rata'Mari's spyreport. He seems to be quite happy with the cheese you brought him.
questlog.quest_20.mission_4.name: Marid Mission 3: The Sleeping Lamp
questlog.quest_20.mission_4.state_1: Gabel asked you to find Fa'hradin's sleeping lamp in the orc fortress at Ulderek's Rock. Then, sneak into Mal'ouqhah and exchange Malor's sleeping lamp with Fa'hradin's lamp.
questlog.quest_20.mission_4.state_2: You successfully exchanged the lamps. Gabel will be happy to hear about this.
questlog.quest_20.mission_4.state_3: The Marid deeply appreciate your help. King Gabel allowed you to trade with Haroun and Nah'bob.
questlog.quest_20.name: The Djinn War - Marid Faction
questlog.quest_21.mission_1.name: Going Down
questlog.quest_21.mission_1.state_2: You sucessfully helped Xorlosh in repairing the elevator. You can now enter the teleporter to the eastern part of the mine.
questlog.quest_21.mission_2.name: Justice for All
questlog.quest_21.mission_2.state_1: Nokmir told you that he is falsely accused of being a thief. You could help him by talking to Grombur about the case. Furthermore you should try to find that ring which belongs to Rerun.
questlog.quest_21.mission_2.state_2: You should talking to Grombur about Nokmir.
questlog.quest_21.mission_2.state_3: You should try to find that ring which belongs to Rerun everywhere in the mine.
questlog.quest_21.mission_2.state_4: You have found Rerun's ring. Bring the ring to the emperor Rehal and talk to him about Nokmir.
questlog.quest_21.mission_2.state_5: You informed emperor Rehal about your recent discoveries and he acquitted Nokmir of being a thief.
questlog.quest_21.mission_2.state_6: You told Nokmir about his acquittal and he granted you access to the northern mine.
questlog.quest_21.mission_3.name: Pythius the Rotten
questlog.quest_21.mission_3.state_1: You won the battle against the malicious undead dragon Pythius the Rotten. He granted you firewalker boots as a reward.
questlog.quest_21.mission_4.name: Sweet as Chocolate Cake
questlog.quest_21.mission_4.state_1: Bake a Chocolate Cake and bring it to Bolfona at the bar.
questlog.quest_21.mission_4.state_2: Report back to Frafnar by telling him about the mission.
questlog.quest_21.mission_4.state_3: You told Frafnar that you did everything he asked you to do. You may now enter the western part of the mine.
questlog.quest_21.mission_5.name: The Good Guard
questlog.quest_21.mission_5.state_1: Grombur asked you to get him a cask of dwarven brown ale. You heard that Boozer in Venore tried to brew some. Maybe you should pay him a visit.
questlog.quest_21.mission_5.state_2: Grombur liked the ale and you are now allowed to enter his part of the mine.
questlog.quest_21.name: The Hidden City of Beregar
questlog.quest_22.mission_1.name: Befriending the Musher
questlog.quest_22.mission_1.state_1: Find Sniffler the husky of Iskan. He should be somewhere north west of the town. He is probably marking his territory so you should be able to find his trace. Call him sniffler and feed him with meat.
questlog.quest_22.mission_1.state_2: Tell Iskan that you found and feed Sniffler
questlog.quest_22.mission_1.state_3: You are now a friend of Iskan and can ask him for a passage to Nibelor. You should ask Hjaern in Nibelor if you can help him.
questlog.quest_22.mission_10.name: Formorgar Mines 2: Ghostwhisperer
questlog.quest_22.mission_10.state_1: Go back to the mine and ask the restless soul about his story.
questlog.quest_22.mission_10.state_2: You already have listen to his story!
questlog.quest_22.mission_11.name: Formorgar Mines 3: The Secret
questlog.quest_22.mission_11.state_1: The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans must learn about it! Hurry before its too late.
questlog.quest_22.mission_11.state_2: The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans are already informed!
questlog.quest_22.mission_12.name: Formorgar Mines 4: Retaliation
questlog.quest_22.mission_12.state_1: Hjaern gave you a spirit charm of cold. Travel to the mines and find four special obelisks to mark them with the charm.
questlog.quest_22.mission_12.state_5: Once all 4 obelisks are marked report back to Hjaern.
questlog.quest_22.mission_12.state_6: You got the Norseman outfit and you have access to the Yakchal room deep in the Formorgar Mines.
questlog.quest_22.mission_13.name: Barbarian Test 1: Barbarian Booze
questlog.quest_22.mission_13.state_1: You participate in the drinking challenge. Now you can get the permission for a few sips of barbarian mead in exchange for some honey.
questlog.quest_22.mission_13.state_2: Now drink from the bucket until you drink 10 sips in a row without passing out
questlog.quest_22.mission_13.state_3: You have mastered the first task of the barbarian test. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.
questlog.quest_22.mission_14.name: Barbarian Test 2: The Bear Hugging
questlog.quest_22.mission_14.state_1: Somewhere north of Svargrond you will find a lonely bear which you have to hug. You wonder what you were thinking when accepting this quest...
questlog.quest_22.mission_14.state_2: You passed the bear hugging test (and should take a bath). If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.
questlog.quest_22.mission_15.name: Barbarian Test 3: The Mammoth Pushing
questlog.quest_22.mission_15.state_1: Find a mammoth north-west of Svargrond and knock it over. You wonder whether your mission is becoming a barbarian or rather commiting suicide.
questlog.quest_22.mission_15.state_2: You have knocked over a mammoth - though you wonder what this crushing noise at your spine was. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about the mammoth pushing.
questlog.quest_22.mission_16.name: The Honorary Barbarian
questlog.quest_22.mission_16.state_8: You are now a honorary barbarian and can become a citizen of Svargrond. If you haven't done so yet, you should look for a barbarian in need of help in the north of the town.
questlog.quest_22.mission_2.name: Nibelor 1: Breaking the Ice
questlog.quest_22.mission_2.state_1: Chakoyas may use the ice for a passage to the west and attack Svargrond. Use the rocks at east of nibelor on at least three of these places and the chakoyas probably won't be able to pass the ice.
questlog.quest_22.mission_2.state_4: You have broke 3 of 3 icepassages! Tell Hjaern your mission!
questlog.quest_22.mission_2.state_5: You should ask Silfind if you can help her in some matters.
questlog.quest_22.mission_3.name: Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism
questlog.quest_22.mission_3.state_1: Siflind send you to travel to a distant land to get ants from an Ant-Hill to perform ecological terrorism on some pirates on Tyrsung. Just use the jug on an anthill.
questlog.quest_22.mission_3.state_2: Now head back to Svargrond and go to Buddel, the drunk sailor in southern Svargrond, and ask him to take you to Tyrsung. Now go all the way to the southern shores where you find a outpost. Go to the bottom deck and use the jug with the western mast
questlog.quest_22.mission_3.state_3: Go tell Siflind that you released the ants and aks her for mission!
questlog.quest_22.mission_4.name: Nibelor 3: Artful Sabotage
questlog.quest_22.mission_4.state_1: Siflind gave you a Vial of Paint to use on some Baby Seals. Go back to Tyrsung and follow the shore from Buddel south. Use the Vial of Paint on three of these seals.
questlog.quest_22.mission_4.state_2: Go tell Siflind that you painted the seals and aks her for mission!
questlog.quest_22.mission_5.name: Nibelor 4: Berserk Brewery
questlog.quest_22.mission_5.state_1: The first things needed are 5 bat wings to brew a berserker elixir. Bring her them!
questlog.quest_22.mission_5.state_2: The next items Siflind need are 4 bear paws. Bring her them!
questlog.quest_22.mission_5.state_3: The next items Siflind need are 3 bonelord eyes. Bring her them!
questlog.quest_22.mission_5.state_4: The next items Siflind need are 2 fish fins. Bring her them!
questlog.quest_22.mission_5.state_5: The next item Siflind need is a green dragon scale. Bring her that!
questlog.quest_22.mission_5.state_6: You helped Siflind to defend Svargrond. Now Nilsor need help, go ask him for mission.
questlog.quest_22.mission_6.name: Nibelor 5: Cure the Dogs
questlog.quest_22.mission_6.state_1: To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 1st of 7 ingredients: a Part of the Sun Adorer Cactus. Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed.
questlog.quest_22.mission_6.state_2: To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 2nd of 7 ingredients: Geyser Water in a Waterskin. Use it on a geyser that is NOT active. The water of active geysers is far too hot.
questlog.quest_22.mission_6.state_3: To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 3rd of 7 ingredients: Fine Sulphur. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole.
questlog.quest_22.mission_6.state_4: To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 4th of 7 ingredients: the Frostbite Herb. You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife.
questlog.quest_22.mission_6.state_5: To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 5th of 7 ingredients: Purple Kiss Blossom. The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom.
questlog.quest_22.mission_6.state_6: To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 6th of 7 ingredients: the Hydra Tongue. The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop.
questlog.quest_22.mission_6.state_7: To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 7th of 7 ingredients: Spores of a Giant Glimmercap Mushroom. The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores.
questlog.quest_22.mission_6.state_8: You found all ingredients to cure Nilsor dogs, ask him for mission. You can now travel by Dog Sleds to Inukaya.
questlog.quest_22.mission_7.name: The Secret of Helheim
questlog.quest_22.mission_7.state_1: Hjaern might have a mission for you. So maybe you go and talk to him.
questlog.quest_22.mission_7.state_2: Hjaern send you to find someone in Svargrond who can give you a passage to Helheim and seek the reason for the unrest there.
questlog.quest_22.mission_7.state_3: You discovered the necromantic altar and should report Hjaern about it.
questlog.quest_22.mission_8.name: The Contact
questlog.quest_22.mission_8.state_1: Get out of Nibelor and go to the Svargrond Explorer's Society. Ask Lurik for the mission.
questlog.quest_22.mission_8.state_2: Get to the raider camp, then follow to the extreme south where you find lots of barbarians. Near the southern most coastline, try looking for the NPC Nor. Ask him about Memory Crystal.
questlog.quest_22.mission_8.state_3: Go back to Lurik and deliver him the memory crystal.
questlog.quest_22.mission_8.state_4: Give Lurik some time to evaluate the information (ca. 5min). Then talk to him again about your mission.
questlog.quest_22.mission_9.name: Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission
questlog.quest_22.mission_9.state_1: Find the entrance of the Formorgar Mines. Find some hint or someone who is willing to talk about what is going on there.
questlog.quest_22.mission_9.state_2: You found a old and tattered written paper in a skeleton next to a Restless Soul, you can only make out a signature: Tylaf, apprentice of Hjaern. Ask Hjaern about Tylaf.
questlog.quest_22.name: The Ice Islands Quest
questlog.quest_23.mission_1.name: Mission 1: Interrogation
questlog.quest_23.mission_1.state_1: Your mission is to investigate the 5 guards in Thais regarding the Heretic behavior. Tim, Kulag, Grof, Miles and Walter are their names. If you do well you see a holy sprite on you.
questlog.quest_23.mission_1.state_2: You investigated 1 of 5 guards in Thais.
questlog.quest_23.mission_1.state_3: You investigated 2 of 5 guards in Thais.
questlog.quest_23.mission_1.state_4: You investigated 3 of 5 guards in Thais.
questlog.quest_23.mission_1.state_5: You investigated 4 of 5 guards in Thais.
questlog.quest_23.mission_1.state_6: You investigated 5 of 5 guards in Thais. Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
questlog.quest_23.mission_1.state_7: You investigated all guards in Thais.
questlog.quest_23.mission_2.name: Mission 2: Eclipse
questlog.quest_23.mission_2.state_1: Henricus tells you to get The Witches' Grimoire, he sends you to Femor Hills where you can fly to the witches' mountain, say Eclipse to Uzon and he will take you there. Use the vial of holy water that he gives you on the big cauldron and open the chest to your left, then bring the witches' grimoire to Henricus.
questlog.quest_23.mission_2.state_2: Find the witches' grimoire and bring it to Henricus.
questlog.quest_23.mission_2.state_3: You already brought the witches' grimoire to Henricus.
questlog.quest_23.mission_3.name: Mission 3: Vampire Hunt
questlog.quest_23.mission_3.state_1: Henricus wants you to find the Dwarfish Vampire Hunter, Storkus, located west of the Dwarf Bridge. It's good idea bring your 20 Vampire Dusts with you to save some time.
questlog.quest_23.mission_3.state_2: Go Back to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.
questlog.quest_23.mission_3.state_3: Now Storkus wants you to kill a vampire lord, The Count in the Green Claw Swamp, The Count is located near to the Blood Herb Quest. To summon The Count, you must use the coffin in the center of the room. Kill it and bring The Ring of the Count to Storkus.
questlog.quest_23.mission_3.state_4: Kill The Count and bring his ring to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.
questlog.quest_23.mission_3.state_5: Return to Henricus and tell him that you finished your job here.
questlog.quest_23.mission_3.state_6: Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
questlog.quest_23.mission_4.name: Mission 4: The Haunted Ruin
questlog.quest_23.mission_4.state_1: Henricus will gave you a Special Flask (vial of holy water). Go to Liberty Bay and use the vial on an old house. Use this vial of holy water on that spot to drive out the evil being.
questlog.quest_23.mission_4.state_2: Kill the Pirate Ghost and get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
questlog.quest_23.mission_4.state_3: You already cleaned the abandoned and haunted house in Liberty, ask Henricus for mission.
questlog.quest_23.mission_5.name: Mission 5: Essential Gathering
questlog.quest_23.mission_5.state_1: Henricus wants 20 Demonic Essences as a proof of your accomplishments.
questlog.quest_23.mission_5.state_2: Now ask Henricus for outfit to get the Demon Hunter Outfit.
questlog.quest_23.mission_5.state_3: You got the Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.
questlog.quest_23.mission_6.name: Mission 6: The Demon Ungreez
questlog.quest_23.mission_6.state_1: Henricus wants you to kill a demon called Ungreez. Head to Edron Hero Cave and go down a few levels.
questlog.quest_23.mission_6.state_2: You killed Ungreez, report your mission to Henricus.
questlog.quest_23.mission_6.state_3: You got the the first addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.
questlog.quest_23.mission_7.name: Mission 7: The Shadow Nexus
questlog.quest_23.mission_7.state_1: Your mission is to go to the Demon Forge and slay seven of The Ruthless Seven Minions. The Demon Forge is located in the Edron Hero Cave, through a portal after the Vampire Shield Quest.
questlog.quest_23.mission_7.state_2: You destroyed the shadow nexus! Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
questlog.quest_23.mission_7.state_3: Now ask to Henricus for a outfit. He will give you the 2nd addon of the Demon Hunter Outfits.
questlog.quest_23.mission_7.state_4: You got the the second addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Go now to the reward room and choose one wisely!
questlog.quest_23.mission_7.state_5: You have completed The Inquisition Quest! You can now buy the Blessing of the Inquisition!
questlog.quest_23.name: The Inquisition

questlog.quest_25.mission_1.name: A Djinn in Love
questlog.quest_25.mission_1.state_1: You need to return to Marina and ask her for a date with Ocelus.
questlog.quest_25.mission_1.state_2: You need to return to Ocelus with the bad news.
questlog.quest_25.mission_1.state_3: Ocelus told you to get a poem for him, if you didn't buy one already, head to Ab'Dendriel and buy a Love Poem from Elvith.
questlog.quest_25.mission_1.state_4: You need to go recite the poem to Marina and impress her with the Djinn's romantic and poetic abilities.

questlog.quest_25.mission_10.name: Ray's Mission 4: Proof of Death
questlog.quest_25.mission_10.state_1: Travel to Nargor and try to find out more about the mission Klaus offers. He apparently wants the death of Ray Striker and your task is to convince him that Ray is dead.
questlog.quest_25.mission_10.state_2: Klaus told you to kill Ray Striker and bring him his lucky pillow as a proof. Ray should be interested in hearing about this mission.
questlog.quest_25.mission_10.state_3: You informed Ray that Klaus needs his lucky pillow as proof of his death. Ray gave it to you, now go convince Klaus that the mission is fulfilled and Ray is Dead!
questlog.quest_25.mission_10.state_4: Klaus belieaves that Ray Striker is dead and will celebrate a big party. You should tell Ray about your successful mission.
questlog.quest_25.mission_10.state_5: Ray was very impressed to hear about your successful mission and gave you a ship and a pirate outfit as reward.

questlog.quest_25.mission_11.state_2: Ariella asked you for a few days of adequate supply. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
questlog.quest_25.mission_11.state_3: You have finished one mission. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
questlog.quest_25.mission_11.state_4: Morgan asked you to deliver a letter safely to old Eremo on Cormaya. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.

questlog.quest_25.mission_15.state_3: You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead black sheep so that he can complete his counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.

questlog.quest_25.mission_16.state_2: You delivered the gold to Charlotta. Return to Eleonore and tell her the secret password: peg leg
questlog.quest_25.mission_17.name: The Governor's Daughter
questlog.quest_25.mission_17.state_1: You promised to find Eleonore's lost ring. She told you that a parrot stole it from her dressing table and flew to the nearby mountains. You might need a rake to retrieve the ring.
questlog.quest_25.mission_17.state_2: You found the ring. Return it to Eleonore.
questlog.quest_25.mission_17.state_3: You returned the ring to Eleonore.
questlog.quest_25.mission_2.name: A Poem for the Mermaid
questlog.quest_25.mission_2.state_1: You need to find the man-stealing mermaid and try to break her spell over poor Raymond, the mermaid Marina is near the northern coast of the island.
questlog.quest_25.mission_2.state_2: You discovered that she does in fact have a spell on him, and will not release him unless someone better comes along.
questlog.quest_25.mission_2.state_3: You are a true master in reciting love poems now. No mermaid will be able to resist if you ask for a date!

questlog.quest_25.mission_4.description: After arranging a date for Marina and Ocelus, you are allowed to use Marina's sea turtles. They will bring you to the idyllic Laguna Islands.
questlog.quest_25.mission_4.name: Access to Laguna Island
questlog.quest_25.mission_5.description: After earning the trust of the governor's daughter Eleonore, Captain Waverider in Liberty Bay will bring you to Meriana if you tell him the secret codeword 'peg leg'.
questlog.quest_25.mission_5.name: Access to Meriana
questlog.quest_25.mission_6.description: After convincing the people in Sabrehaven that you are a trustworthy hero, Sebastian will sail you to Nargor.
questlog.quest_25.mission_6.name: Access to Nargor
questlog.quest_25.mission_7.name: Ray's Mission 1: Fafnar's Fire
questlog.quest_25.mission_7.state_1: Ray Striker asked you to travel to Edron and pretend to the alchemist Sandra that you are the one whom the other pirates sent to get the fire. When she asks for a payment, tell her 'Your continued existence is payment enough'.
questlog.quest_25.mission_7.state_2: Sandra will be enraged and will cut any deals with pirates. Report back to Raymond Striker.
questlog.quest_25.mission_7.state_3: Ray Striker was pleased to hear about Sandra's rage. If you haven't done so yet, ask him for other missions.
questlog.quest_25.mission_8.name: Ray's Mission 2: Sabotage

questlog.quest_25.mission_8.state_2: You were able to sabotage the catapult in the pirate's harbor. Report back to Ray Striker to tell him about mission.
questlog.quest_25.mission_8.state_3: Ray Striker was pleased to hear about successful sabotage. If you haven't done so yet, ask him for other missions.
questlog.quest_25.mission_9.name: Ray's Mission 3: Spy Mission
questlog.quest_25.mission_9.state_1: Travel to Nargor and try to enter de pirate's tavern by deceiving the guard in front of it. Read all the plans which you can find in the tavern and report back to Striker.
questlog.quest_25.mission_9.state_2: You studied all of the pirate's plans in their tavern which will give insight about their next strikes. If you haven't done so yet, ask Ray for another mission.

questlog.quest_26.mission_4.state_2: Snake Eye told you to visit Ahmet in Ankrahmun.
questlog.quest_26.mission_4.state_3: Ahmet told you that he will only help a friend and asked you to kill at least one Nomad.
questlog.quest_26.mission_4.state_4: You have killed a Nomad, go back to Ahmet!
questlog.quest_26.mission_4.state_5: You have received the forged documents from Ahmet, next is to get a disguise from Percybald in Venore!
questlog.quest_26.mission_4.state_6: You have received the dwarf disguise from Percybald. Now go do the deal with Nurik.
questlog.quest_26.mission_4.state_7: You have traded the forged documents for the painting, report back to Dorian.
questlog.quest_26.mission_4.state_8: You have delivered the painting to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
questlog.quest_26.mission_5.name: Mission 5: Enforcing Debts
questlog.quest_26.mission_5.state_1: Your mission is to travel to Tiquanda. Fina a hidden smuggler cave to the north of Port Hope and try to retrieve the valuable goblet which Dorian is looking for. Once you got it, bring it to him.
questlog.quest_26.mission_5.state_2: You have delivered the golden goblet to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
questlog.quest_26.mission_6.name: Mission 6: Fishnapping
questlog.quest_26.mission_6.state_1: Dorian wants you to fishnap Theodore Loveless' fish, first you need to get the key to his room. Talk to Chantalle in Liberty Bay.
questlog.quest_26.mission_6.state_2: You have received the key for Theodore Loveless' room, time to fishnap his fish!
questlog.quest_26.mission_6.state_3: You have fishnapped Theodore Loveless' fish, deliver it to Dorian.
questlog.quest_26.mission_6.state_4: You have delivered the fish to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
questlog.quest_26.mission_7.name: Mission 7: Blackmail
questlog.quest_26.mission_7.state_1: Your current task is to find compromising information about one of the Venore city guards, no matter how. A good starting point might be in their barracks.
questlog.quest_26.mission_7.state_2: You have delivered the compromising letter to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
questlog.quest_26.mission_8.name: Mission 8: Message
questlog.quest_26.mission_8.state_1: Dorian wants you to deliver a message to his competitors in the dark cathedral.
questlog.quest_26.mission_8.state_2: You have put up the message, report back to Dorian.
questlog.quest_26.mission_8.state_3: You have reported back that you have completed the mission, Dorian now allows you to trade with Black Bert.
questlog.quest_26.name: The Thieves Guild
questlog.quest_27.mission_1.name: Mission 1: Trophy
questlog.quest_27.mission_1.state_1: Your first mission for becoming a recognized trader is to bring the traveling salesman Rashid a Deer Trophy.
questlog.quest_27.mission_1.state_2: You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
questlog.quest_27.mission_2.name: Mission 2: Delivery
questlog.quest_27.mission_2.state_1: Your mission is to get the package from Willard the weapon dealer at Edron.
questlog.quest_27.mission_2.state_2: Willard forgot to pick it up from Snake Eye at Outlaw Camp. So he wants you to go and pick it up from Snake Eye.
questlog.quest_27.mission_2.state_3: Take the package just next door.
questlog.quest_27.mission_2.state_4: Now bring back the package to Rashid.
questlog.quest_27.mission_2.state_5: You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
questlog.quest_27.mission_3.name: Mission 3: Cheese
questlog.quest_27.mission_3.state_1: Rashid wants you to pick his special order from Miraia in Darashia. But you have to be quick, Scarab cheese can rot really fast in high temperature.
questlog.quest_27.mission_3.state_2: Now quickly bring back the Scarab cheese to Rashid.
questlog.quest_27.mission_3.state_3: You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
questlog.quest_27.mission_4.name: Mission 4: Vase
questlog.quest_27.mission_4.state_1: Rashid have ordered a special elven vase from Briasol in Ab'Dendriel. He asks you to buy it from Briasol and bring it back. But you should be carefully, since the vase is very fragile.
questlog.quest_27.mission_4.state_2: Now carefully bring the vase back to Rashid.
questlog.quest_27.mission_4.state_3: You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
questlog.quest_27.mission_5.name: Mission 5: Make a deal
questlog.quest_27.mission_5.state_1: This time, Rashid is testing your trading skills to buy a Crimson Sword from Uzgod. But it have to be less than 400 gold coins and the quality has to be perfect.
questlog.quest_27.mission_5.state_2: Now bring the sword back to Rashid.
questlog.quest_27.mission_5.state_3: You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
questlog.quest_27.mission_6.name: Mission 6: Goldfish
questlog.quest_27.mission_6.state_1: Rashid wants you to bring him a Goldfish Bowl.
questlog.quest_27.mission_6.state_2: You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
questlog.quest_27.mission_7.name: Mission 7: Declare
questlog.quest_27.mission_7.state_1: Rashid has declare you as one of his recognized traders, and now you are able to trade with him anytime..
questlog.quest_27.name: The Travelling Trader Quest
questlog.quest_28.mission_1.name: Joining the Explorers
questlog.quest_28.mission_1.state_1: The mission should be simple to fulfil. You have to seek out Uzgod in Kazordoon and get the pickaxe for us. Or just find dwarven pickaxe on your own...
questlog.quest_28.mission_1.state_2: Get into Dwacatra and get Uzgod's family brooch.
questlog.quest_28.mission_1.state_3: Bring family brooch back to Uzgod
questlog.quest_28.mission_1.state_4: Bring the pickaxe back to the Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_1.state_5: You have completed Joining the Explorers
questlog.quest_28.mission_10.name: The Rune Writings
questlog.quest_28.mission_10.state_42: Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons that were once inhabited by lizards. Look there for an atypical structure that would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure.
questlog.quest_28.mission_10.state_43: Report back to the Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_10.state_44: You have completed The Rune Writings.
questlog.quest_28.mission_11.name: The Ectoplasm
questlog.quest_28.mission_11.state_45: Take ectoplasm container and use it on a ghost that was recently slain.
questlog.quest_28.mission_11.state_46: Return back to the Explorer Society representative with the collected ectoplasm.
questlog.quest_28.mission_12.name: The Spectral Dress
questlog.quest_28.mission_12.state_48: The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. Try to get a spectral dress from her.
questlog.quest_28.mission_12.state_49: Report to the Explorer Society with the spectral dress.
questlog.quest_28.mission_13.name: The Spectral Stone
questlog.quest_28.mission_13.state_51: Please travel to our second base and ask them to mail us their latest research reports. Then return here and ask about new missions.
questlog.quest_28.mission_13.state_52: Tell our fellow explorer that the papers are in the mail already.
questlog.quest_28.mission_13.state_53: Take the spectral essence and use it on the strange carving in this building as well as on the corresponding tile in our second base.
questlog.quest_28.mission_13.state_54: Good! Now use the spectral essence on the strange carving in our second base.
questlog.quest_28.mission_14.name: The Astral Portals
questlog.quest_28.mission_14.state_56: Both carvings are now charged and harmonised. You are able to travel in zero time from one base to the other, but you need to have an orichalcum pearl in your possession to use it as power source.
questlog.quest_28.mission_15.name: The Island of Dragons
questlog.quest_28.mission_15.state_57: Travel to Okolnir and try to find a proof for the existence of dragon lords there in the old times. I think old Buddel might be able to bring you there.
questlog.quest_28.mission_15.state_58: Report back to Lurik with the dragon scale.
questlog.quest_28.mission_16.name: The Ice Music
questlog.quest_28.mission_16.state_60: There is a cave on Hrodmir, north of the southernmost barbarian camp Krimhorn. In this cave, there are a waterfall and a lot of stalagmites. Take the resonance crystal and use it on the stalagmites in the cave to record the sound of the wind.
questlog.quest_28.mission_16.state_62: Now you may use the Astral Bridge from Liberty Bay to Svargrond.
questlog.quest_28.mission_17.name: The Undersea Kingdom
questlog.quest_28.mission_17.state_1: Le capitaine Max vous amènera à Calassa dès que vous serez prêt. Veuillez essayer de récupérer le journal de bord manquant qui doit se trouver dans l'une des épaves coulées.
questlog.quest_28.mission_17.state_2: Report about your Calassa mission to Berenice in Liberty Bay.
questlog.quest_28.mission_17.state_3: Congratulations, you completed the remaining part of this mission!
questlog.quest_28.mission_2.name: The Ice Delivery
questlog.quest_28.mission_2.state_6: Take this ice pick and use it on a block of ice in the caves beneath Folda. Get some ice and bring it here as fast as you can. If the ice melt away, report on your ice delivery mission anyway.
questlog.quest_28.mission_2.state_7: You have 10 minutes before the icicle defrosts. Run back to the Explorer Society representative!
questlog.quest_28.mission_2.state_8: You have completed The Ice Delivery.
questlog.quest_28.mission_3.name: The Butterfly Hunt
questlog.quest_28.mission_3.state_10: Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_3.state_12: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a BLUE butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a BLUE butterfly.
questlog.quest_28.mission_3.state_13: Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_3.state_15: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a RED butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a RED butterfly.
questlog.quest_28.mission_3.state_16: Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_3.state_17: You have completed The Butterfly Hunt.
questlog.quest_28.mission_3.state_9: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a PURPLE butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a PURPLE butterfly.
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.name: The Plant Collection
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.state_18: Take botanist's container. Use it on a jungle bells plant to collect a sample.
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.state_19: Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.state_20: Ask for plant collection when you are ready to continue.
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.state_21: Use botanist's container on a witches cauldron to collect a sample.
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.state_22: Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.state_23: Ask for plant collection when you are ready to continue.
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.state_24: Use this botanist's container on a giant jungle rose to obtain a sample.
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.state_25: Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_4.state_26: You have completed The Plant Collection.
questlog.quest_28.mission_5.name: The Lizard Urn
questlog.quest_28.mission_5.state_27: In the south-east of Tiquanda is a small settlement of the lizard people. Beneath the newly constructed temple there, the lizards hide the urn. Acquire an ancient urn which is some sort of relic to the lizard people of Tiquanda.
questlog.quest_28.mission_5.state_28: Bring the Funeral Urn back to the Explorer Society.
questlog.quest_28.mission_5.state_29: You have completed The Lizard Urn.
questlog.quest_28.mission_6.name: The Bonelord Secret
questlog.quest_28.mission_6.state_30: Travel to the city of Darashia and then head north-east for the pyramid. If any documents are left, you probably find them in the catacombs beneath.
questlog.quest_28.mission_6.state_31: Bring the Wrinkled Parchment back to the Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_6.state_32: You have completed The Bonelord Secret.
questlog.quest_28.mission_7.name: The Orc Powder
questlog.quest_28.mission_7.state_33: As far as we can tell, the orcs maintain some sort of training facility in some hill in the north-east of their city. There you should find lots of their war wolves and hopefully also some of the orcish powder.
questlog.quest_28.mission_7.state_34: Bring the Strange Powder to the Explorer Society representative to complete your mission.
questlog.quest_28.mission_7.state_35: You have completed The Orc Powder.
questlog.quest_28.mission_8.name: The Elven Poetry
questlog.quest_28.mission_8.state_36: This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel Hellgate beneath Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
questlog.quest_28.mission_8.state_37: Bring back an elven poetry book to the Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_8.state_38: You have completed The Elven Poetry.
questlog.quest_28.mission_9.name: The Memory Stone
questlog.quest_28.mission_9.state_39: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone.
questlog.quest_28.mission_9.state_40: Bring back a memory stone to the Explorer Society representative.
questlog.quest_28.mission_9.state_41: You have completed The Memory Stone.
