questlog.quest_30.mission_1.name: Access to the Isle of Kings
questlog.quest_30.mission_1.state_1: You are a friend of Dalbrect. Since you returned his family brooch he will sail you to the Isle of Kings unless you do something stupid.
questlog.quest_30.mission_2.name: The Investigation
questlog.quest_30.mission_2.state_1: Investigate the catacombs. Abbot Costello should be interested in information about brother Fugio.
questlog.quest_30.mission_2.state_2: You returned Fugio's Diary. Costello was very thankful about your help and gave you a blessed ankh as reward.
questlog.quest_30.name: The White Raven Monastery
questlog.quest_31.mission_1.name: To Appease the Mighty
questlog.quest_31.mission_1.state_1: Kazzan sent you to talk with Ubaid and Umar to offer an appeasement treaty to the Djinn races. Talk to Umar first.
questlog.quest_31.mission_1.state_2: Umar said he won't be part of Kazzan's plans. Now you need to try with Ubaid.
questlog.quest_31.mission_1.state_3: Umar and Ubaid said they won't be part of those plans. Return to Kazzan and collect your reward.
questlog.quest_31.mission_10.name: The Ultimate Booze
questlog.quest_31.mission_10.state_1: Boozer in Vernore asked you to bring him some special dwarven brown ale. You may find some in the brewery in Kazordoon.
questlog.quest_31.mission_10.state_2: You found the special dwarven brown ale. Bring it to Boozer in Vernore.
questlog.quest_31.mission_10.state_3: You have completed The Ultimate Booze Quest!
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.name: Jack to the Future
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_1: Spectulus told you about a failed experiment he once did, involving an intern named Jack, and asked you to help him rescue Jack. Go to Jack's house and talk to him about Spectulus.
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_10: Spectulus found out that you were convincing the wrong Jack. His real intern was transported way back to the past. He left a note years ago which, to your misery, reached Spectulus a little too late.
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_2: You have talked to Jack and found out that he is not remembering the time accident or Spectulus. Return to Spectulus in the Edron Academy to tell him about your findings.
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_3: Spectulus wants you to trigger Jack's memory. Jack used to like his red cushioned chair, an old globe, a telescope, a large amphora and a rocking horse. Place those in his room and ask him about it.
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_4: You have talked to Jack about the furniture you placed in his house. Report it back to Spectulus in the Edron Academy.
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_5: Spectulus sent you once again to his former intern Jack. Explain the incident to the people close to him. Talk to Jack's mother and sister and return to Spectulus to report their reaction.
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_6: You have talked with Jack's mother and sister. Report it back to Spectulus.
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_7: Spectulus suggested asking Jack abouthis hobbies. Make Jack leave his hobby be by whateber means it takes. Only by doing this he will be separated from what distracts him from his former self.
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_8: You found out and destroyed Jack's hobby. Jack is now finally ready and beginning to change. He event seems to start remembering Spectulus and the Academy.
questlog.quest_31.mission_11.state_9: Jack is finally remembering Spectulus and the Academy. Report back your mission.
questlog.quest_31.mission_12.name: The Cursed Crystal
questlog.quest_31.mission_12.state_0: A pirate told you about an evil artifact down in the crystal caves under Nargor.It is a big crystal that affects the caves in a negative manner. Perhaps a jarring,very loud sound could destroy it.
questlog.quest_31.mission_12.state_1: You found an old inscription to a mysterious recipe: 'vial of emb... fl... and mix ... a medusa's bl... Then ... the dust of ... crystal ... get Medusa's Ointm... able to unpetrify ...'
questlog.quest_31.mission_12.state_2: You mixed the proper ingredients to create a special salve. The Medusa's Ointment. With this balm you may unpetrify a petrified object.
questlog.quest_31.mission_12.state_3: With the Medusa's Ointment you unpetrified a banshee's scream near the evil crystal. Thus the baleful artefact was destroyed. You should return to One-Eyed Joe.
questlog.quest_31.mission_13.name: Hidden Threats
questlog.quest_31.mission_13.state_1: You have talked to Corym Ratter. He asked you to find the reason why the amount of  delivered ores is decreasing. You got access to the mine.
questlog.quest_31.mission_13.state_2: You have met Corym Servant. He told you the true story of enslaved corym working under  terrible conditions. You have agreed to help him planing a riot. First you have to liberate his comrades.
questlog.quest_31.mission_13.state_3: You have found two key fragments. They are quite rusted. It is necessary to remove the  rust before forging them together. You have to find a way to rebuild the key. This might open the doors.
questlog.quest_31.mission_13.state_4: With the forged key you have unlocked the three areas. The Corym Servant was very relieved  and asked you to bring 20 units of rare earth.
questlog.quest_31.mission_13.state_5: You have brought 20 units of rare earth to Corym Servant. He was very thankful and gave you  a reward. The revolution should now take place as intended.
questlog.quest_31.mission_14.name: To Outfox a Fox
questlog.quest_31.mission_14.state_1: Budrik asked you to look for the hideout of the Horned Fox and bring his stolen mining helmet back. The Fox's lair is presumed to be west of Kazordoon near the coast.
questlog.quest_31.mission_14.state_2: You succesfully helped Budrik in stealing back his old mining helemt.
questlog.quest_31.mission_15.name: Fish for a Serpent
questlog.quest_31.mission_15.state_1: Your first task is to bring 5 fish.
questlog.quest_31.mission_15.state_2: Your second task is to bring 5 northern pike.
questlog.quest_31.mission_15.state_3: Your third task is to bring 5 green perch.
questlog.quest_31.mission_15.state_4: Your forth task is to bring 5 rainbow trout.
questlog.quest_31.mission_15.state_5: You bring enough fish to make the bait. Now you're ready for the hunt.
questlog.quest_31.mission_16.name: The hunt for the Sea Serpent
questlog.quest_31.mission_16.state_2: You navigated the ship to the right location. You are now able to dive down and explore the caves.
questlog.quest_31.mission_2.name: Arito's Task
questlog.quest_31.mission_2.state_1: Arito asked you to make a peace agreement between him and the Nomads.
questlog.quest_31.mission_2.state_2: Return to Arito and tell him the good news.
questlog.quest_31.mission_2.state_3: Now Arito are safe and you have access to Nomads Cave.
questlog.quest_31.mission_3.name: Lion's Rock
questlog.quest_31.mission_3.state_11: By solving the gem puzzle you unveiled the last secret of the Lion's Rock. You drew a treasure out of the ornamented fountain in the lower temple areas.
questlog.quest_31.mission_3.state_4: You have passed the three tests of Lion's Rock and thus lit the three mystical pyramids. You may enter the inner sanctum now. - What other secrets could be hidden down there?
questlog.quest_31.mission_3.state_5: You found a mysterious scroll in the debris of an old amphora. It seems it could help to translate the old temple inscriptions.
questlog.quest_31.mission_3.state_9: In the north-west area of the Inner Sanctum, find the southern rectangular room to the south-west. In this room you will find 4 "sun" floor inscriptions as well as a rock in the center. The sun inscriptions represent gem slots.
questlog.quest_31.mission_4.name: Against the Spider Cult
questlog.quest_31.mission_4.state_1: Daniel Steelsoul in Edron wants you to infiltrate the Edron Orc Cave and destroy 4 Spider Eggs.
questlog.quest_31.mission_4.state_2: You destroyed 1 of 4 Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave
questlog.quest_31.mission_4.state_3: You destroyed 2 of 4 Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave
questlog.quest_31.mission_4.state_4: You destroyed 3 of 4 Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave
questlog.quest_31.mission_4.state_5: You destroyed all Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave, report back to Daniel Steelsoul!
questlog.quest_31.mission_5.name: An Interest In Botany
questlog.quest_31.mission_5.state_1: Rabaz in Farmine asked you to collect samples from rare plant specimen in Zao. Go to the storage room to the west and receive the Botany Almanach. Find then the Giant Dreadcoil and use your Obsidian Knife on it to obtain a sample.
questlog.quest_31.mission_5.state_2: Now you must find the second plant, a Giant Verminous and use your Obsidian Knife on it to obtain a sample.
questlog.quest_31.mission_5.state_3: You found the two samples, report back to Rabaz in Farmine!
questlog.quest_31.mission_6.name: Graves Sanctified - In Progress
questlog.quest_31.mission_7.name: Into the Bone Pit
questlog.quest_31.mission_7.state_1: Search the Cursed Bone Pit in the dungeon north of Thais and dig for a well-preserved human bone for Muriel.
questlog.quest_31.mission_7.state_2: You have found a desecrated bone for Muriel.
questlog.quest_31.mission_7.state_3: You helped Muriel to obtain a desecrated bone.
questlog.quest_31.mission_8.name: Rest in Hallowed Ground
questlog.quest_31.mission_8.state_1: Go to the white raven monastery and ask for some holy water for Amanda.
questlog.quest_31.mission_8.state_2: You got the holy water from the white raven monastery. Go back to Amanda and report about your mission.
questlog.quest_31.mission_8.state_3: Sanctify every single grave at the unholy graveyard north of Edron with the holy water.
questlog.quest_31.mission_8.state_4: You have sanctified all graves at the unholy graveyard of Edron. Report about your mission at Amanda.
questlog.quest_31.mission_8.state_5: You helped Amanda by sanctifying the cursed graveyard of Edron.
questlog.quest_31.mission_9.name: The Exterminator
questlog.quest_31.mission_9.state_1: Padreia in Carlin asked you to exterminate the slimes in the sewers of Carlin by poisoning their spawn pool.
questlog.quest_31.mission_9.state_2: You poisoned the spawn pool of the slimes in the sewers of Carlin. Report to Padreia about your mission.
questlog.quest_31.mission_9.state_3: You successfully helped Padreia in saving Carlin from a slimy disease.
questlog.quest_31.name: Tapis Contes
questlog.quest_32.mission_1.name: Mission 1: Skulled
questlog.quest_32.mission_1.state_1: Your mission is to find the Holy Skull. It is in a cave in the northern orc settlement, which is located north-west on the Zao Steppe.
questlog.quest_32.mission_1.state_2: You found the Holy Skull. Retrieve it to Lazaran in the Zao Mountains.
questlog.quest_32.mission_1.state_3: You brought Lazaran the Holy Skull. Ask him for new mission!
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.name: Mission 2: All Around the World
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_1: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Edron.
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_10: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Thais
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_11: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Carlin
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_12: You visited all the highest places with the skull. Turn the skull back to Lazaran and report him your mission!
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_13: You turned the skull already back to Lazaran. Ask him for new mission!
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_2: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Ab'dendriel.
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_3: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Femor Hills.
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_4: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Darashia
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_5: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Ankrahmun
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_6: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Port Hope
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_7: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Liberty Bay
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_8: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Yalahar
questlog.quest_32.mission_2.state_9: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Svargrond
questlog.quest_32.mission_3.name: Mission 3: Dance Dance Evolution
questlog.quest_32.mission_3.state_1: Lazaran told you to go to Ulala, who is located above Lazaran.
questlog.quest_32.mission_3.state_2: Ulala told you to dance to please their god Krunus. On the south mountain in the camp you will find the Krunus altar, there are lots of leaves on the ground.
questlog.quest_32.mission_3.state_3: You solved the dance. Head back to Ulala and report your mission!
questlog.quest_32.mission_4.name: Mission 4: Bits and Pieces
questlog.quest_32.mission_4.state_1: Now the god Krunus is pleased, another god called Pandor needs to be pleased. Ulala wants you to collect 5 Orc Teeth, 5 Minotaur leathers and 5 Lizard Leathers. Bring them to her.
questlog.quest_32.mission_4.state_2: You brought Ulala 5 Orc Teeth, 5 Minotaur leathers and 5 Lizard Leathers. Ask her for new mission!
questlog.quest_32.mission_5.name: Mission 5: Ray of Light
questlog.quest_32.mission_5.state_1: The third god which needs to be pleased is called Fasuon. Find the great crystal on top of mountain of Fasuon and pray there for his support!
questlog.quest_32.mission_5.state_2: You already prayed at the great crystal. Report it to Ulala
questlog.quest_32.mission_5.state_3: You have reported back to Ulala that you have completed the mission.
questlog.quest_32.mission_6.name: Mission 6: Firewater Burn
questlog.quest_32.mission_6.state_1: Speak with Lazaran and tell the gods are pleased now.
questlog.quest_32.mission_6.state_2: Bring Lazaran a Pot of brown water for a party after the great hunt.
questlog.quest_32.mission_6.state_3: You brought Lazaran the beer and got a Serpent Crest as reward!
questlog.quest_32.name: Unnatural Selection
questlog.quest_33.mission_1.name: What a foolish Quest - Tasks of a Fool
questlog.quest_33.mission_1.state_1: Cut a flower at the Whiteflower Temple south of Thais. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_1.state_2: You have finished your first mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_10.name: What a foolish Quest - A sweet surprise
questlog.quest_33.mission_10.state_1: Deliver a cookie to Avar Tar, Simon, Ariella, Lorbas, King Markwin, Hjaern, Wyda, Hairycles, the orc king and EITHER Yaman OR Nah'Bob. Then report to Bozo about the mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_10.state_2: You have finished your tenth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_11.name: What a foolish Quest - The final foolishness
questlog.quest_33.mission_11.state_1: Gather 5 pieces of white cloth for Bozo. Then report about your mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_11.state_2: Travel to Darama and climb the highest point of the Plague Spike to give these pieces of white cloth an old and worn look. Some ancient altar should suit your needs best - use the white cloth on it.
questlog.quest_33.mission_11.state_3: Use your mummy disguise to scare the caliph Kazzan in Darashia. DON'T use the disguise too early or you will fail the quest.
questlog.quest_33.mission_11.state_4: You have finished all of Bozo's missions and you are a complete fool now. Yay!
questlog.quest_33.mission_12.name: What a foolish Quest - To become a complete fool
questlog.quest_33.mission_12.state_4: Now that you have a basic outfit, you should talk to Bozo about your missions to gain further rewards.
questlog.quest_33.mission_2.name: What a foolish Quest - That stinks!
questlog.quest_33.mission_2.state_1: It sometimes stinks to be a fool. Collect some noxious fumes from a recently slain slime with the special vial. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_2.state_2: You have finished your second mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_3.name: What a foolish Quest - A Piece of Cake
questlog.quest_33.mission_3.state_1: Get 12 pies from Mirabell in Edron. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_3.state_2: You have finished your third mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_4.name: What a foolish Quest - Fool Spirits
questlog.quest_33.mission_4.state_1: Get 18 vials of wine for Bozo. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_4.state_2: Exchange the crates in front of Xodet's house and return to Bozo with the swapped crate.
questlog.quest_33.mission_4.state_3: You have finished your fourth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_5.name: What a foolish Quest - Watch out for the foolish
questlog.quest_33.mission_5.state_1: Steal the magic watch from the Triangle Tower west of Jakundaf Desert. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_5.state_2: Use the magic watch to steal the beard of the sleeping dwarven emperor.
questlog.quest_33.mission_5.state_3: You have already finished five missions for that fool. You should definitely talk to Bozo about your jester outfit now!
questlog.quest_33.mission_6.name: What a foolish Quest - The queen of farts
questlog.quest_33.mission_6.state_1: Get Bozo 4 pieces of minotaur leather.
questlog.quest_33.mission_6.state_2: Get Bozo a piece of giant spider silk.
questlog.quest_33.mission_6.state_3: Ask Bozo about your mission, he might be finished with the whoopee cushion by now.
questlog.quest_33.mission_6.state_4: Place the whoopee cushion on the queen's throne in Carlin by using the cushion with the throne.
questlog.quest_33.mission_6.state_5: You have finished your sixth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_7.name: What a foolish Quest - For your mice only
questlog.quest_33.mission_7.state_1: Get the toy mouse of Queen Eloise's cat and show it to Carina, the jeweler in Venore, to scare her.
questlog.quest_33.mission_7.state_2: You have finished your seventh mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_8.name: What a foolish Quest - Smoking is a foolish thing
questlog.quest_33.mission_8.state_1: Gather some easily inflammable sulphur using a spoon on an inactive lava hole.
questlog.quest_33.mission_8.state_2: You brought Bozo the sulphur. Now cut him some leaves of the jungle dweller bush with a kitchen knife.
questlog.quest_33.mission_8.state_3: You have gathered the ordered ingredients and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_8.state_4: Deliver the exploding cigar to Theodore Loveless in Liberty Bay.
questlog.quest_33.mission_8.state_5: You have finished your eighth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_9.name: What a foolish Quest - A fool's bargain
questlog.quest_33.mission_9.state_1: Bozo wants you to fill a vial with the blood of a stalker. Use the vial on a slain stalker immediately after his death. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_9.state_2: Bozo wants you to fill a vial with the ink of a quara constrictor. Use the vial on a slain constrictor immediately after its death. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_9.state_3: You have gathered the ordered ingredients and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.mission_9.state_4: Order 2000 steel shields from Sam. Sign his contract with the magic ink.
questlog.quest_33.mission_9.state_5: You have finished your ninth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
questlog.quest_33.name: What a foolish Quest
questlog.quest_34.mission_1.name: Mission 01: Catering the Lions Den
questlog.quest_34.mission_1.state_1: You must bring Zalamon 3 nails and a piece of wood so that he can make a Marked Crate for you.
questlog.quest_34.mission_1.state_2: Go to the tunnel in eastern Muggy Plains and reach the other side. Try to hide in the dark and avoid being seen at all by using the crate. After that you need to find the rebel hideout and talk to their leader Chartan.
questlog.quest_34.mission_1.state_3: You passed the maintenance tunnel and successfully made contact with the resistance in their hideout north of the Great Gate.
questlog.quest_34.mission_10.name: Mission 10: A Message of Freedom
questlog.quest_34.mission_10.state_1: After solving the riddle, and talking again to the Sleeping Dragon you got a Spiritual Charm. Report back to Zizzle.
questlog.quest_34.mission_10.state_2: You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. Start with the one in the north-west and work your way clockwise trough the room and kill those manifestation. Then use your sceptre on the remain to destroy the emperor's influence over the crystal.
questlog.quest_34.mission_10.state_3: You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed 1 of 4 emperor's influences.
questlog.quest_34.mission_10.state_4: You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed 2 of 4 emperor's influences.
questlog.quest_34.mission_10.state_5: You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed 3 of 4 emperor's influences.
questlog.quest_34.mission_10.state_6: You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed all emperor's influences.
questlog.quest_34.mission_11.name: Mission 11: Payback Time
questlog.quest_34.mission_11.state_1: Your Mission is to kill Zalamon. Step into the teleporter to confront him. Finally use your sceptre on the death body.
questlog.quest_34.mission_11.state_2: Go back to Awareness Of The Emperor and report him your success!
questlog.quest_34.mission_12.name: Mission 12: Just Rewards
questlog.quest_34.mission_12.state_0: The Emperor has promised you wealth beyond measure. Go claim it in the ministry.
questlog.quest_34.mission_2.name: Mission 02: First Contact
questlog.quest_34.mission_2.state_1: Chartan needs you to reactivate the teleport to the Muggy Plains. Head downstairs and into the temple and craft material to repair the teleport. To do this you will need some tools to improvise.
questlog.quest_34.mission_2.state_2: As you give the coal into the pool the corrupted fluid begins to dissolve, leaving purified, refreshing water. The teleporter is reactivated. Report back to Chartan.
questlog.quest_34.mission_2.state_3: Report back to Zalamon for the next mission.
questlog.quest_34.mission_3.name: Mission 03: The Keeper
questlog.quest_34.mission_3.state_1: Zalamon gives you a Flask of Plant Poison to destroy plants in the garden of the Emperor to lure out and kill The Keeper to get his tail. The garden is southeast of the rebel hideout.
questlog.quest_34.mission_3.state_2: You killed the Keeper and got his tail. Bring it to Zalamon.
questlog.quest_34.mission_3.state_3: You brought the tail of the Keeper to Zalamon and completed the mission. Ask for the next mission.
questlog.quest_34.mission_4.name: Mission 04: Sacrament of the Snake
questlog.quest_34.mission_4.state_1: Zalamon now wants you to go to Deeper Banuta and get an Ancient Sceptre that will help in the fight against the emperor. On each floor under Deeper Banuta you collect a sceptre part from a Ghost of a Priest. On the 4th and final floor you need to assemble the sceptre..
questlog.quest_34.mission_4.state_2: After you've assembled the Snake Sceptre and fought your way back out, head back to Zalamon and give it to him.
questlog.quest_34.mission_4.state_3: You have delievered the recreated sceptre to the rebels.
questlog.quest_34.mission_5.name: Mission 05: New in Town
questlog.quest_34.mission_5.state_1: Enter the imperial city Razachai to the west and talk to your contact in the ministry there for further missions.
questlog.quest_34.mission_5.state_2: Now you only have to walk west until you find Zlak inside the big green building.
questlog.quest_34.mission_5.state_3: You went deep inside the city to find Zlak and completed the mission. Ask for the next mission.
questlog.quest_34.mission_6.description_: Kill four Magistrati in the office building. Then report back to Zlak. You have killed %d magistrati so far.
questlog.quest_34.mission_6.name: Mission 06: The Office Job
questlog.quest_34.mission_7.description_: Kill six nobles in the city and report back to Zlak. You have killed %d nobles so far.
questlog.quest_34.mission_7.name: Mission 07: A Noble Cause
questlog.quest_34.mission_8.name: Mission 08: Uninvited Guests
questlog.quest_34.mission_8.state_1: Use the old escape tunnel in the northern basement of the ministry to enter the imperial palace. Fight your way to the basement to meet your new rebel contact.
questlog.quest_34.mission_8.state_2: You have reached your rebel contact Zizzle in the imperial palace.
questlog.quest_34.mission_9.name: Mission 09: The Sleeping Dragon
questlog.quest_34.mission_9.state_1: To enter the inner realms of the Emperor you need to free the mind of a dragon. An interdimensional potion will help you to enter this dream and unleash his consciousness.
questlog.quest_34.mission_9.state_2: You travelled through the Sleeping Dragon dreams and freed his mind.
questlog.quest_34.name: Wrath of the Emperor
questlog.quest_35.mission_1.description: Five Juicy roots from the outskirts of Rathleton may already help feed the poor. Try to find a city official to deliver them to or go to the Rathleton poor house.
questlog.quest_35.mission_1.name: To Take Roots
questlog.quest_35.name: Oramond
questlog.quest_36.mission_1.name: Circle of the Black Sphinx
questlog.quest_36.mission_1.state_1: You defeated the rogue Lady Tenebris.
questlog.quest_36.mission_2.name: Bane of the Cosmic Force
questlog.quest_36.mission_2.state_1: You calmed poor, misguided Lloyd. All he wanted was protection from the outside world. Luckily he seems to have learned his lesson... or has he?
questlog.quest_36.mission_3.name: The Desecrated Glade
questlog.quest_36.mission_3.state_1: You defeated the Thorn Knight and shattered the root of evil with all your might. The honor of being a guardian of the glade indeed comes with pride as well as responsibility.
questlog.quest_36.mission_4.name: The Unwary Mage
questlog.quest_36.mission_4.state_1: With help of Ivalisse from the temple of the Astral Shapers in Thais and her father, you averted the Dragon King's menace deep in the Zao Muggy Plains.
questlog.quest_36.mission_5.name: Dragon in Distress
questlog.quest_36.mission_5.state_1: You saved the Dragon Mother's egg and she melted the ice wall that blocked your way.
questlog.quest_36.mission_6.name: Time is a Window
questlog.quest_36.mission_6.state_1: You defeated the Time Guardian and are free to return to your own time. For some creatures in this world, it seems neither past nor future are an obstacle.
questlog.quest_36.mission_7.name: Final Fight
questlog.quest_36.name: Forgotten Knowledge
questlog.quest_37.mission_1.name: Power
questlog.quest_37.mission_2.description: Treasure is the favorite of the dragon lords. Find and take Kalyassa's treasures spread across the world.
questlog.quest_37.mission_2.name: Treasure
questlog.quest_37.mission_3.description: You learned that frost dragon's incitement is the thirst for knowledge, perhaps if you bring some to Gelidrazah's you'll meet him.
questlog.quest_37.mission_3.name: Knowledge
questlog.quest_37.mission_4.description: Undead dragons aspires for life. No better way to see life as it grows around the world, is there?
questlog.quest_37.mission_4.name: Life
questlog.quest_37.name: The First Dragon
questlog.quest_38.mission_1.description_:
James asked you to enter the cave for hunting 50 empowered minotaurs. Then he will be able to continue his research.
Minotaurs killed: %d/50
questlog.quest_38.mission_1.name: The Strengthtening of the Minotaurs
questlog.quest_38.mission_2.name: The Strengthtening of the Minotaurs
questlog.quest_38.mission_2.state_1: Gerimor told you that the naturalist Jamesfrancis is an expert of minotaurs. Right now he is investigating a cave in minocity. But this time something seems to be completely different.
questlog.quest_38.mission_2.state_2: Jamesfrancis already entered the inner part of the cave weeks ago but had to flee when the minotaurs became too strong. He gave you the key to investigate this room as well.
questlog.quest_38.mission_2.state_3: You found an entrance to the minotaur boss. You killed it and now you have to return to Jamesfrancis.
questlog.quest_38.mission_2.state_4: Jamesfrancis sent you to talk with Gerimor about the minotaur cult.
questlog.quest_38.mission_2.state_5: You have reported the Druid of Crunor about the minotaur cult.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.name: Patron of Arts
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_1: The Druid of Cronor gave you the hint that the Thais exhibition has expanded. The new section is called MOTA (Museum of Tibian Arts). It's really worth a visit.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_10: After you told Gareth about the fake painting, he asked you to go to Angelo to get a new picture.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_11: Angelo was not willing to give you a new picture. However, they havent found any artefact in the sandy cave yet. Report to Gareth about your failure.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_12: Even though you weren't successful in getting a replacement for the fake picture, Gareth gave you access to the last floor of the museum. This area is for patrons only.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_13: INTERNAL MESSAGE: THIS NEED QUESTLOG INFORMATION
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_14: The Denomintator opened the door for you after you answered his questions to the wanted number. In the end he mentioned the Druid of Conor. Maybe you should pay him a visit.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_15: In the end you told the Druid of Crunor about your experiences in the MoTA.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_2: Gareth told you how to become a patron of the arts. To fulfil your duty you have to manage some tasks. First you have to investigate the crime scene of a theft in the museum.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_3: You found a ransom note, wich requests you to pay some money for the stolen picture to a stonge in Kazordoon. His name is Iwar. Nevertheless I should talk to Gareth first.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_4: You told Gareth about the ransom note. He asked you to pay the money to Iwar to get the picture back. In his opinion, there is no alternative.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_5: You paid the money to stooge in Kazordoon. You were told that the picture is delivered to Gareth himself.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_6: You have to go to Angelo and get a magnifier to investigate all small pictures in the entrance hall of the MOTA. One of them should be a fake.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_7: Angelo allowed you to take a magnifier from a crate next to the cave entrance.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_8: You've fetched the magnifier from Angelo's crate. You're ready for your job in the museum.
questlog.quest_38.mission_3.state_9: Indeed! One of the investigated small pictures is fake. Report to Gareth!
questlog.quest_38.mission_4.name: Mort
questlog.quest_38.mission_4.state_1: The members of the Barkless follow a rigid path of hardship and sacrifice. Their cult is located somewhere beneath Ab'dendriel. Whatever happened to their leader, only a true Barkless can find out.
questlog.quest_38.mission_4.state_2: You survived the sulphur and tar trial. You accepted the stigma of misfortune and vanity. The hardest part, however, is yet to come. Give your life to the ice... to become true and purified.
questlog.quest_38.mission_4.state_4: You broke enough Barkless markings to now reverse the seal held up by the cult object in the ritual chamber. The power you gained feels unnatural and excessive but it seems ther is no other way.
questlog.quest_38.mission_4.state_5: Something far more powerful than the beliel of your Barkless brothers and sisters powered the seal to the leader. Whatever the case - find Leiden, or as he's known to his devotees: the "Penitent".
questlog.quest_38.mission_4.state_6: The Leiden you confronted has strayed far from his own original vision of Barkless. What you encountered was more monster than elf and less virtuous than his devotees would have you believe.
questlog.quest_38.mission_4.state_7: You returned to Gerimor after putting an end to the mischief of Leyden the Penitent. May the Barkless walk the true path again one day.
questlog.quest_38.mission_5.name: Misguided
questlog.quest_38.mission_5.state_2: Below a ruin in the vicinity of the outlaw camp east of Thais a strange figure in ragged clothes hinted at something weird going on in a cave. He seemed too confused to decide whether to stop you.
questlog.quest_38.mission_5.state_4: You defeated the cult leader of Misguided by uncovering the true master to pull his strings and freeing this world from its malicious existance. Return to Gerimor to tell him about the victory.
questlog.quest_38.mission_5.state_5: You have spoken to Gerimor about your victory.
questlog.quest_38.mission_6.name: The Orc Idol
questlog.quest_38.mission_6.state_3: You returned to Gerimor after facing the being the orcs worshipped. Whatever it was, it did not find the orcs by accident. A far more powerful force seems to have strategically place it here.
questlog.quest_38.mission_7.name: The Secret of the Sandy Cave
questlog.quest_38.mission_7.state_10: You have told Gerimor about your stay in the sandy cave. He was not really surprised and felt vindicated that the rumors about a cult in the cave might be true.
questlog.quest_38.mission_7.state_3: In the cave you haven't found one of the missing scientists. However, you have faced a lots of strange mummies and a green oasis at the end.
questlog.quest_38.mission_7.state_4: After you informed Angelo about your experiences in the cave, he asked you to go back to analyse the water of the oasis. For that reason you got an analysis tool.
questlog.quest_38.mission_7.state_5: You have analysed the water with the help of the analysis tool from Angelo.
questlog.quest_38.mission_7.state_6: You informed Angelo about the analyzed water. He gave you a counteragent, wich you have to apply to the oasis.
questlog.quest_38.mission_7.state_7: You applied the counteragent to the oasis, just like Angelo had asked you to. But the effect was different from what you had expected. A sandstorm approached and caused create damage to the oasis.
questlog.quest_38.mission_7.state_9: You reported your victory to Angelo
questlog.quest_38.mission_8.name: Zathroth Remmants
questlog.quest_38.mission_8.state_3: You returned to Gerimor after encounter with the remnants of Zathroth. On one hand its is furtunate that Zathroth indeed wasn't behind all this, but on the other... what is going on there?
questlog.quest_38.name: Cults of Tibia
questlog.quest_39.mission_1.name: Dwarves: Home Improvement
questlog.quest_39.mission_1.state_2: You drove off the Lost but more are sure to come. Check back with Klom Stonecutter at a later time.
questlog.quest_39.mission_2.name: Dwarves: Subterranean Life
questlog.quest_39.mission_2.state_2: You helped Klom defend the outpost by cutting down a number of vermin from deep down below. The gnomes don't seem to completely approve of this but everyone appreciates the drop in the enemy's ranks.
questlog.quest_39.mission_3.name: Gnomes: Gnomal Warming Measurements
questlog.quest_39.mission_3.state_2: You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.
questlog.quest_39.mission_4.name: Gnomes: Ordnance
questlog.quest_39.mission_4.state_1: Gnomus sent you to find and rescue the gnome ordnance the outpost is currently waiting for. Travel to the east of the cave system and find the old gnome trail where reinforcements will arrive.
questlog.quest_39.mission_4.state_3: You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.
questlog.quest_39.mission_5.name: Gnomes: Uncharted Territory
questlog.quest_39.mission_5.state_2: You helped Gnomus chart the area around the deep base. You found traces of what could have been an old civilisation but there's not enough left to draw any conclusion.
questlog.quest_39.mission_6.name: Scouts: Explosive Growth
questlog.quest_39.mission_6.state_2: You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.
questlog.quest_39.mission_7.name: Scouts: Pesticide
questlog.quest_39.mission_7.state_2: You reported back to Lardoc Bashsmite to inform him that the gnome's plan to neutralise diremaw corpses seems to work.
questlog.quest_39.name: Dangerous Depths
questlog.quest_4.mission_1.name: The Birthday Presents
questlog.quest_4.mission_1.state_1: Gather the material Tereban listed. Talk to him about your mission when you have given him everything he was looking for.
questlog.quest_4.mission_1.state_2: You brought all the required materials to Tereban and guaranteed his sons a great birthday party.
questlog.quest_4.mission_2.name: The Magic Bow - Sinew
questlog.quest_4.mission_2.state_1: Find the wyvern Heoni in the Edron mountains and take his sinew to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.mission_2.state_2: You delivered Heoni's sinew to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.mission_3.name: The Magic Bow - Wood
questlog.quest_4.mission_3.state_1: Find the special wood in the barbarian camps of Hrodmir and bring it to Tereban. It might be a good idea to start looking in the northernmost camp.
questlog.quest_4.mission_3.state_2: You delivered the Wood to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.mission_4.name: The Magic Robe - Cloth
questlog.quest_4.mission_4.state_1: Find the spectral cloth hidden deep in the crypts of the isle of the kings and bring it to Tereban. You might have to look for a secret entrance.
questlog.quest_4.mission_4.state_2: You delivered the spectral cloth to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.mission_5.name: The Magic Robe - Silk
questlog.quest_4.mission_5.state_1: Find exquisite silk in the spider caves of southern Zao and deliver it to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.mission_5.state_2: You brought Tereban the required silk.
questlog.quest_4.mission_6.name: The Magic Rod - Crystal
questlog.quest_4.mission_6.state_1: Find a magic crystal in the tomb buried under the sand east of Ankrahmun and bring it to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.mission_6.state_2: Tereban received the magic crystal he was looking for.
questlog.quest_4.mission_7.name: The Magic Rod - Root
questlog.quest_4.mission_7.state_1: Find the mystic root under the city of Banuta and bring it to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.mission_7.state_2: The magic root was delievered to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.mission_8.name: The Magic Shield - Iron
questlog.quest_4.mission_8.state_1: Find some old iron in the mines of Kazordoon for Tereban. Don't get lost - start searching close to the city.
questlog.quest_4.mission_8.state_2: Tereban got the old iron he required.
questlog.quest_4.mission_9.name: The Magic Shield - Scale
questlog.quest_4.mission_9.state_1: Find the dragon Glitterscale in the caves north of Thais and take its scale to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.mission_9.state_2: You handed the looted scale to Tereban.
questlog.quest_4.name: A Father's Burden
questlog.quest_40.mission_1.description_: You are exploring the Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs. Others obviously found a terrible end here. But the dragon hoards might justify the risks. You killed %d/50 dragons and dragon lords.
questlog.quest_40.mission_1.name: The Great Dragon Hunt
questlog.quest_40.mission_2.name: The Lost Brother
questlog.quest_40.mission_2.state_1: At the Kha'zeel Mountains you met the merchant Tarun. His brother has gone missing and was last seen following a beautiful woman into a palace. Tarun fears this woman might have been a demon.
questlog.quest_40.mission_2.state_2: You found the remains of Tarun's brother containing a message. Go back to Tarun and report his brother's last words.
questlog.quest_40.mission_2.state_3: You told Tarun about his brother's sad fate. He was very downhearted but gave you his sincere thanks. The beautiful asuri have taken a young man's life and the happiness of another one.
questlog.quest_40.name: Adventurers Guild
questlog.quest_41.mission_1.description: You have reached the Outpost, where young heroes are trained in combat and hunting. When you have reached level 8 at least, you can leave for the Mainland. Talk to Inigo if you have questions.
questlog.quest_41.mission_1.name: In the Adventures Outpost
questlog.quest_41.mission_2.name: The Lost Amulet
questlog.quest_41.mission_2.state_1: Mr Morris tasked you to find an ancient amulet that was lost somewhere on Dawnport - probably next to a corpse somewhere.
questlog.quest_41.mission_2.state_3: Mr Morris thanks for you the help.
questlog.quest_41.mission_3.name: The Stolen Log Book
questlog.quest_41.mission_3.state_1: Mr Morris urged you to find a log book that was stolen by trolls.
questlog.quest_41.mission_3.state_2: Mr Morris thanks you for the help.
questlog.quest_41.mission_4.name: The Rare Herb
questlog.quest_41.mission_4.state_1: Mr Morris needs the rare Dawnfire herb harvested and brought to him. It grows on gray sand only, he said.
questlog.quest_41.mission_4.state_3: Mr Morris thanks you for the help.
questlog.quest_41.mission_5.name: The Dorm Key
questlog.quest_41.mission_5.state_1: The key to the adventurer's dormitory has disappeared. Maybe you can find it. Ask around to find out who was the last to have seen it.
questlog.quest_41.mission_5.state_2: Use the fishing rod in the nearby lake to fish Old Nasty.
questlog.quest_41.mission_5.state_3: Come back to Woblin with Old Nasty
questlog.quest_41.mission_5.state_4: Come back to Mr Morris with Key 0010
questlog.quest_41.mission_5.state_5: Mr Morris thanks for the help
questlog.quest_41.mission_6.name: Task: A Toll on Trolls
questlog.quest_41.mission_7.description_: You already hunted %d/20 Muglex Clan Footman.
questlog.quest_41.mission_7.name: Task: The Goblin Slayer
questlog.quest_41.mission_8.name: Task: Plus Minos a Few
questlog.quest_41.name: Dawnport
questlog.quest_42.mission_1.name: Mission 01: A Taste of Things to Come
questlog.quest_42.mission_10.name: Mission 10: Tomb Raiding
questlog.quest_42.mission_10.state_1: Leave the village to the north and walk south-east to find the haunted graveyard. Descend into the crypt and find a sarcophagus that might still contain a fleshy bone. Bring it to Vascalir.
questlog.quest_42.mission_10.state_2: You've brought the fleshy bone back to Vascalir. Talk to him again to receive your reward.
questlog.quest_42.mission_10.state_3: You managed to get a fleshy bone from the crypt! Who knows what Vascalir plans with it - but this is going to be good.
questlog.quest_42.mission_11.name: Mission 11: Sweet Poison
questlog.quest_42.mission_11.state_1: Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the west, then walk south-west to find a wasp lair. Make sure you don't lose the flask Vascalir gave you.
questlog.quest_42.mission_11.state_2: You've found the wasp lair. Kill one wasp and use the empty flask on its dead body to retrieve some of its poison.
questlog.quest_42.mission_11.state_3: You've retrieved some lethal wasp poison. Bring it back to Vascalir to complete the mission.
questlog.quest_42.mission_11.state_4: You brought Vascalir the highly toxic poison. You should talk to him again to receive your reward.
questlog.quest_42.mission_11.state_5: You've retrieved highly toxic wasp poison for Vascalir. It's time for your final challenge.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.name: Mission 12: Into The Fortress
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_1: This is it - the infiltration of the orc fortress and revenge on Kraknaknork awaits. Get the required items from a chest in the academy near the bank.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_10: You've entered Kraknaknork's room. Find a way to get rid of the energy barriers.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_11: You solved the riddle of the energy barriers. The way to the throne room should be clear - for a short time. Be prepared for a massive fight!
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_12: You've entered Kraknaknork's throne room. Fight him! You can back out at any time via the teleporter, but you'll have to start the battle over. Once he is dead, enter the teleporter near his throne.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_13: You've vanquished Kraknaknork and found his treasure room. You can probably take a few things from there before you leave - he wouldn't care anymore.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_14: With the last bit of Kraknaknork's energy, you were teleported out of the fortress. Time to return to Vascalir victoriously.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_15: You've vanquished Kraknaknork and brought peace to the village of Rookgaard. It will soon be time for you to leave for the Isle of Destiny, choose a vocation and enter the open world of Tibia.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_2: You've got all items you need to finally kill Kraknaknork. Don't lose them, and carefully make your way towards the orc fortress located in the far west of Rookgaard. Leave the village to the north.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_3: You've knocked out the unsuspecting orc. USE the orc before it wakes up again to disguise yourself as an orc!
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_4: Even your mom wouldn't recognise you. You might not be able to fool all orcs in your disguise, but it should be enough to walk past the orc guarding the entrance.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_5: You managed to sneak into the fortress. Use the fleshy bone and click on the elite orc guard with the crosshairs to create a distraction!
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_6: The guard is indeed very distracted - he smells delicious. At least to the wild dogs that entered the scene. This is the perfect time to enter the lower levels of the orc fortress.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_7: You're inside the orc fortress! Now you need to find a kitchen and something that looks like a soup cauldron. Use the wasp poison on the cauldron to create an evil surprise for Kraknaknork.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_8: You "spiced up" Kraknaknork's breakfast. Let's see how strong he still is after his meal. Proceed further into the fortress - and keep your tarantula trap ready.
questlog.quest_42.mission_12.state_9: You managed to slow down the furious orc berserker. Now, run through the teleporter while he isn't close to it!
questlog.quest_42.mission_2.name: Mission 02: Defence!
questlog.quest_42.mission_2.state_1: Vascalir promised you some equipment, but first you need to build up some muscles. Find a big pile of stone in a barn to the north and use it to get a heavy stone.
questlog.quest_42.mission_2.state_2: You retrieved one stone from the big pile. Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to use it on.
questlog.quest_42.mission_2.state_3: You loaded a stone on one of the catapults. One more to go! Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to load with a heavy stone.
questlog.quest_42.mission_2.state_4: Two of the four catapults on the roofs are loaded. That should be enough to build up a decent defence. Return to Vascalir to turn in your quest.
questlog.quest_42.mission_2.state_5: You made sure that Rookgaard's defences are at their best. If the orcs try to enter the village, they won't have an easy time!
questlog.quest_42.mission_3.description_: Vascalir sent you to the Rookgaard sewers to kill 5 rats. You have already killed %d/5. Return to Vascalir once you're done.
questlog.quest_42.mission_3.name: Mission 03: A Rational Request
questlog.quest_42.mission_4.name: Mission 04: Home-Brewed
questlog.quest_42.mission_4.state_1: Vascalir doesn't have a job for you at the moment. He sent you to Lily in the south-west of town for another mission.
questlog.quest_42.mission_4.state_2: Lily gave you a bag with fresh herbs that need to be delivered to Hyacinth outside of the village. Leave the village to the north and walk east to find his little hut up a mountain.
questlog.quest_42.mission_4.state_3: You've delivered the fresh herbs to Hyacinth. He still has a reward for you though - make sure to talk to him again!
questlog.quest_42.mission_4.state_4: Hyacinth has another reward for you - make sure to talk to him again with enough space in your inventory.
questlog.quest_42.mission_4.state_5: You've delivered the herbs to Hyacinth and got potions and a ring as reward. Save the potions for when you're low on health and wear the ring if you want to regain health faster. Return to Vascalir.
questlog.quest_42.mission_4.state_6: You've told Vascalir about your successful delivery. The next mission awaits.
questlog.quest_42.mission_5.name: Mission 05: Web of Terror
questlog.quest_42.mission_5.state_1: Vascalir sent you to the spider queen's lair to retrieve a web sample. Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the north-west to find the lair. Look for greasy blue stones.
questlog.quest_42.mission_5.state_2: You've covered yourself in grease. It's a bit disgusting, but the spider queen will not be able to smell you for about two minutes. Enter her cave and USE an intact spider web to retrieve a sample.
questlog.quest_42.mission_5.state_3: You retrieved some of the spider queen's web. Return to Vascalir and try not to get caught by the queen on the way out!
questlog.quest_42.mission_5.state_4: The spider queen caught you in her net. If you had a sample of her web, you've lost it. Find a way out of her net and retry!
questlog.quest_42.mission_5.state_5: Vascalir took the sample from you. He still has a studded armor for you - talk to him once you have enough space in your inventory.
questlog.quest_42.mission_5.state_6: You've brought the spider queen's web back to Vascalir. This will definitely come in handy later on.
questlog.quest_42.mission_6.name: Mission 06: Run Like a Wolf
questlog.quest_42.mission_6.state_1: Vascalir sent you to Tom the Tanner, who can be found to the west of the academy. There you will get your next mission.
questlog.quest_42.mission_6.state_2: Leave the village to the north and walk north-east into the forest to find the wolves' den that Tom told you about. Hopefully you will find that poacher to take some leather from him!
questlog.quest_42.mission_6.state_3: You've entered the wolves' den - that was a one-way fall, but luckily you didn't get hurt. The poacher you were looking for is dead - but that doesn't mean you can't get some war wolf leather!
questlog.quest_42.mission_6.state_4: You've skinned a war wolf - but you alerted the wolf pack! Run to the exit, quickly!
questlog.quest_42.mission_6.state_5: RUN! You have only a limited time to reach the exit with the war wolf leather!
questlog.quest_42.mission_6.state_6: Phew - you managed to get out of the wolves' den in time. Return to Tom to finish your mission.
questlog.quest_42.mission_6.state_7: Tom gave you a pair of leather boots as reward for your good work. Vascalir surely has a new mission for you now.
questlog.quest_42.mission_7.name: Mission 07: Attack!
questlog.quest_42.mission_7.state_1: While you were gone, trolls have infiltrated the academy and set it on fire! Enter the burning vault deep underground and try to recover the copy of the book of orc language before it's destroyed.
questlog.quest_42.mission_7.state_2: You've done all you could - but unfortunately the book is lost. No need to lose heart though - there is still hidden knowledge about the orc language in the village, and the next mission awaits.
questlog.quest_42.mission_8.name: Mission 08: Less Risk - More Fun
questlog.quest_42.mission_8.state_1: Before getting revenge on the trolls, eliminate the risk of losing money on the way. Paulie has an interesting bonus offer for you if you deposit your money at the bank. Find him below the academy.
questlog.quest_42.mission_8.state_2: You've done as Vascalir asked and talked to Paulie. Remember to always leave your gold on your account! That way there's no risk of losing it.
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.name: Mission 09: Rock 'n Troll
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_1: Enter the troll lair to the north of the village and find the new tunnel which the trolls dug and used to infiltrate the Rookgaard academy. There, you need to find a way to destroy it.
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_10: The trolls will not be able to enter the academy via their tunnel again. The village is safe for now - at least from trolls.
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_2: Open the chests in the tunnel and use the pick on the 5 beams to weaken the structure and make the tunnel collapse.
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_3: You've weakened one of five beams.
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_4: You've weakened two of five beams.
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_5: You've weakened tree of five beams.
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_6: You've weakened four of five beams.
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_7: You've weakened all the beams! Hurry out of the tunnel before it collapses!
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_8: The tunnel collapsed behind you. Time to return to Vascalir.
questlog.quest_42.mission_9.state_9: Vascalir rewarded you with experience, but there's still something he has to give you. You should talk to him again.
questlog.quest_42.name: The Rookie Guard
questlog.quest_43.mission_1.name: Mission 01: New Land
questlog.quest_43.mission_1.state_1: Explore the new land and reach the bottom of the mountain.
questlog.quest_43.mission_1.state_2: You have found a passage from the mountains. You can report back to Ongulf.
questlog.quest_43.mission_1.state_3: You have reported the scouted route to Ongulf.
questlog.quest_43.mission_10.name: Mission 5: Support of the Thaian King
questlog.quest_43.mission_10.state_1: Talk to King Tibianus in the Thaian Castle.
questlog.quest_43.mission_10.state_2: Find an item that interests King Tibianus to get another chance.
questlog.quest_43.mission_11.name: Mission 5: Support of the Venorean Traders
questlog.quest_43.mission_11.state_1: Talk to Leeland Slim, the representative of the Venorean Traders.
questlog.quest_43.mission_11.state_2: Find an item that interests Leeland Slim to get another chance.
questlog.quest_43.mission_12.name: Mission 06: Days Of Doom
questlog.quest_43.mission_12.state_1: Try to pacify the orcs of the steppe. It is probably necessary to find some leader of the orcish tribes.
questlog.quest_43.mission_12.state_2: You have talked to the minotaur leaders of the orcs. They agreed to spare Farmine if you prove your worth in their arena. You will have to survive against Mooh'Tah master for 2 minutes, so prepare!
questlog.quest_43.mission_12.state_3: You have survived the arena. Talk to Curos again about your mission.
questlog.quest_43.mission_12.state_4: Your negotiations had moderate success. Your can report back to Ongulf.
questlog.quest_43.mission_12.state_5: You have ensured a brittle peace between Farmine and the orcs.
questlog.quest_43.mission_13.name: Mission 07: Messengers Of Peace
questlog.quest_43.mission_13.state_1: Find a lizardman somewhere in the north and try to start a negotiation of peace.
questlog.quest_43.mission_13.state_2: It seems that the lizardmen are not interested in peace and you will have to focus on other problems at hand.
questlog.quest_43.mission_14.name: Mission 08: An Offer You Can't Refuse
questlog.quest_43.mission_14.state_1: Captured by lizardmen trap you have to find a way out of the prison. Perhaps something in your cell might lead you to an opportunity for freedom.
questlog.quest_43.mission_14.state_2: You managed to find a way of the captivity of the lizardmen - but for a price.
questlog.quest_43.mission_15.name: Mission 09: Mortal Combat
questlog.quest_43.mission_15.state_1: You are expected to participate in the great tournament of the lizard race. Travel to the Isle of Strife and brave the challenges there.
questlog.quest_43.mission_15.state_2: You are the champion of the great tournament! Still the lizardmen are a menace to behold. You should report to Chrak before you leave the isle.
questlog.quest_43.mission_15.state_3: You have reported your latest doings to Chrak. It seems you bought the dwarfs some time of peace. Only the dragon kings may know how long though.
questlog.quest_43.mission_16.name: Mission 10: New Horizons
questlog.quest_43.mission_16.state_1: Ongulf will be anxious to learn about your latest adventures. Travel back to Farmine for a final report.
questlog.quest_43.mission_16.state_2: Ongulf got very satisfied with your journey, this land is yours to be taken. You can find now on top of the mountain a red carpet, it might offer you access to some cities.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.name: Tome of Knowledge Counter
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_1: You brought the fist Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the lizard culture. Pompan will sell you dragon tapestries from now on.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_10: You brought the tenth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the lizard dynasty. Now you can enter the Zao Palace. It is situated deep underground, below the mountain base of the Lizards.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_11: You brought the eleventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about dragons and their symbolism. You can buy a Dragon Statue from NPC Cael after you bring him a Red Lantern.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_12: You brought the twelfth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something about reveals some of the power structures in Zao. Cael will now make a Dragon Throne for you after you bring him a Red Piece of Cloth. He will reward you with 5000 experience points for each extra tome you give to him.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_2: You brought the second Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the minotaur culture. Pompan will sell you minotaur backpacks from now on.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_3: You brought the third Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the draken culture. Esrik will sell you lizard weapon rack from now on.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_4: You brought the fourth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about a certain food that the lizardmen apparently prepare. Swolt will trade you a bunch of ripe rice for 10 rice balls from now on.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_5: You brought the fifth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the lizards in the South, Zzaion. Pompan will sell you lizard backpacks from now on.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_6: You brought the sixth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt a few things about the primitive human culture on this continent. Cael will sell you War Drums and Didgeridoo from now on.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_7: You brought the seventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about the Zao steppe. Now you to use the snake teleport at the peak of the mountain.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_8: You brought the eighth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt a few things about an illness. Now you can enter a corruption hole in the north-eastern end of Zao.
questlog.quest_43.mission_17.state_9: You brought the ninth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about the Draken origin. Esrik will buy lizard equipment from you now.
questlog.quest_43.mission_2.name: Mission 02: From Kazordoon With Love
questlog.quest_43.mission_2.state_1: Find Melfar of the imperial mining guild close to a mine entrance west of Kazordoon. Ask him to send more miners and wood.
questlog.quest_43.mission_2.state_2: Prepare the three trees which Melfar marked on your map with the beaver bait. Once you've marked all three return to Melfar and tell him about your success.
questlog.quest_43.mission_2.state_3: Melfar has finally promised to send more miners and wood. Report this to Ongulf in Farmine.
questlog.quest_43.mission_2.state_4: You have reported that Melfar will send more miners and wood for Farmine.
questlog.quest_43.mission_3.name: Mission 03: Strangers in the Night
questlog.quest_43.mission_3.state_1: Find the unknown stalkers somewhere in the mountains. They apparently climbed up somewhere during their escape. Try to negotiate a peaceful agreement if possible.
questlog.quest_43.mission_3.state_2: You have talked to the leader of the primitive humans and have assured their peacefulness. Report this to Ongulf back in the base.
questlog.quest_43.mission_3.state_3: You have negotiated a peacful agreement between the dwarfs and the local primitives.
questlog.quest_43.mission_4.name: Mission 04: The Mine Is Mine
questlog.quest_43.mission_4.state_1: Free the mine of the monstrous threat. Use a lift to reach the mines and look for a leader of the stone creatures. Slay this creature and report back to Ongulf.
questlog.quest_43.mission_4.state_2: You have slain the monster that terrorised the mines.
questlog.quest_43.mission_5.name: Mission 05: Getting Things Busy
questlog.quest_43.mission_5.state_1: Try getting the support of the people mentioned. Talk to them about "farmine", then choose the "flatter", "threaten", "impress", "bluff", "reason" or "plea" and report any progress to Ongulf.
questlog.quest_43.mission_5.state_2: You have gained the necessary support for Farmine.
questlog.quest_43.mission_6.name: Mission 5: Support of Kazordoon's Worm Tamer
questlog.quest_43.mission_6.state_1: Talk to the worm tamer in Kazordoon.
questlog.quest_43.mission_6.state_2: Find an item that interests Humgolf to get another chance.
questlog.quest_43.mission_7.name: Mission 5: Support of the Edron Academy
questlog.quest_43.mission_7.state_1: Talk to the magician Wyrdin in the Edron Academy.
questlog.quest_43.mission_7.state_2: Find an item that interests Wyrdin to get another chance.
questlog.quest_43.mission_8.name: Mission 5: Support of the Explorer Society
questlog.quest_43.mission_8.state_1: Talk to the representative of the Explorer Society in Port Hope.
questlog.quest_43.mission_8.state_2: Find an item that interests Angus to get another chance.
questlog.quest_43.mission_9.name: Mission 5: Support of the Inventor Telas
questlog.quest_43.mission_9.state_1: Talk to the inventor Telas in Edron.
questlog.quest_43.mission_9.state_2: Find an item that interests Telas to get another chance.
questlog.quest_43.name: The New Frontier
questlog.quest_44.mission_1.name: Method
questlog.quest_44.mission_1.state_1: Use the item on the tombstones.
questlog.quest_44.mission_1.state_2: You have used these item in the tombstones.
questlog.quest_44.mission_2.name: First Mission
questlog.quest_44.mission_2.state_3: Talk to Sinclair and take the ghost residue.
questlog.quest_44.mission_3.name: Second Mission
questlog.quest_44.mission_3.state_5: You need to get more samples of ghosts.
questlog.quest_44.mission_3.state_6: You got all the ghost scraps.
questlog.quest_44.name: Spirithunters Quest
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.name: Troubled Animals
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_1: You met the talking white deer Alkestios. It turned out he is actually a fae - and needs help. Search out a poacher camp noth of the Green Claw Swamps and keep the poachers from hunting white deers.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_10: You redeemed the ghostly wolf. You should return to Ikassis and tell her about it.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_11: Ikassis was happy to hear that you redeemed the ghostly wolf. But she asked you to help someone else: one of her sisters. You can find her in the guise of swan at a river sourth-east of Ikassis.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_12: You met a swan that in truth is a swan maiden, a kind of fae. These fae have magical cloaks that allow them to shape change between swan and girl. Find this maiden's cloak that was stolen by a troll.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_13: The troll Grarkharok sold the cloak to Tereban and he lost it during a flight with magic carpet. The cloak's feathers are now scattered along the carpet's beeline between Edron and Darashia.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_14: You found many swan feathers on Edron and in Darama desert. Now you should have enough for an entire cloak. You should talk to the swan maiden.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_15: You found enough magical swan feathers. The swan maiden will now be able to restore her cloak. You should talk to Alkestios again.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_16: Alkestios was very happy about your support. You earned the Fae's trust and may now enter their secret realm. Search for an elemental shrine of ice, fire, earth or energy to reach Feyrist.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_2: You found a book with legends in the poacher camp. You asked Ahmed to add a story about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer, hopefully the poachers will desist from hunting Alkestios.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_3: You returned to the poacher camp and placed the faked book noticeably on a table. You're quite sure the poachers will discover it soon and desist from hunting Alkestios.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_4: Alkestios asked you for help on another issue. There seemms to be a problem with a wolf mother and her whelps. Find the snake Ikassis in the north-west of Edron and talk to her, she knows more.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_5: The snake Ikassis asked you to find a female wolf in the south of Cormaya. The animal is in need of help, yet Ikassis didn't know any details.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_6: You found the ghostly wolf and promised to search for her lost whelps. The wolf told you to start your search at Ulderek's Rock
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_7: At Ulderek's Rock you found a sleeping war wolf. It might actually be the now grown up whelp you were looking for. The skeleton nearby implies that the hunter didn't survive his misdeed.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_8: You talked to Irmana in Venore and she gave you the fur of one of the wolf whelps you're searching for. You should talk to their mother's ghost.
questlog.quest_45.mission_1.state_9: As the ghostly wolf asked you, you placed the whelp fur in the mouth of a nearby stone, that is shaped like a big face.
questlog.quest_45.mission_2.name: Nightmare Intruders
questlog.quest_45.mission_2.state_2: You killed 200 of the nightmare monsters that are invading Feyrist. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems she still has other problems. She may need your help once more.
questlog.quest_45.mission_2.state_3: Maelyrra asked you to retrieve an artefact for her: the moon mirror. It was stolen by the tainted fae who inhabit the caves underneath Feyrist. She also asked you to free some captured fairies.
questlog.quest_45.mission_2.state_4: You found the moon mirror and freed the captured fairies. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems she has another problem. Perhaps you should offer your assistance once more.
questlog.quest_45.mission_2.state_5: The barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world is weakened. To strengthen it again you need to find the starlight vial and the sun catcher. Ask Aurita and Taegen for these items.
questlog.quest_45.mission_2.state_6: Gather sunlight, starlight and moon rays. You have to do this with the sun catcher on the beach, with the starlight vial high in the mountains and with the moon mirror on a glade in the forest.
questlog.quest_45.mission_2.state_7: You may now repair the barrier. Charge the five moon sculptures of Feyrist with moon rays, the five dreambird trees with starlight and the five sun mosics with sunlight.
questlog.quest_45.mission_2.state_8: You repaired tha magical barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world. The fae's secret realm is safe again.
questlog.quest_45.mission_3.name: An Unlikely Couple
questlog.quest_45.mission_3.state_1: Help Aurita and Taegen and find a spell to transform Aurita's fishtail into legs temporarily. A fairy in a small fae village in the southwest of Feyrist might know more.
questlog.quest_45.mission_3.state_2: You have succesfully created the magical music notes for the mermaid Aurita. Talk to the faun Taegen, he also needs your help.
questlog.quest_45.mission_3.state_3: The faun Taegen wants to spend some time with his lover, the mermaid Aurita. He wants to visit her home and thus must be able to breath under water. Therefore he needs the rare raven herb.
questlog.quest_45.mission_3.state_4: You found the rare raven herb and gave it to Taegen. Now he will create a sun catcher for you. You may also ask Aurita for the starlight vial now.
questlog.quest_45.name: Threatened Dreams
questlog.quest_46.mission_1.name: Mission 01: Gaining Trust
questlog.quest_46.mission_1.state_1: Think of a way to earn Julius' trust and prove that you are not a vampire. Once you thought of something, talk to him again about your mission.
questlog.quest_46.mission_2.name: Mission 02: Bad Eggs
questlog.quest_46.mission_2.state_1: Bake garlic cookies by using the garlic dough on a baking tray before you put it on the oven. Hand out cookies to the citizens and watch their reactions. Report any suspicious people to Julius.
questlog.quest_46.mission_2.state_2: You have reported five suspects - probably vamires - to Julius.
questlog.quest_46.mission_3.name: Mission 03: His True Face
questlog.quest_46.mission_3.state_1: Use the magic words 'alori mort' in front of the suspicious citizens you discovered to hopefully reveal who among them is their leader.
questlog.quest_46.mission_3.state_3: You reported the incident with Armenius to Julius.
questlog.quest_46.mission_4.name: Mission 04: The Dark Lands
questlog.quest_46.mission_4.state_1: Your task is to find someone to bring you to Vengoth. Explore the island and use Julius' map whenever you find an unusual spot to mark it. Mark at least 5 spots including the castle and report back.
questlog.quest_46.name: Blood Brothers

questlog.quest_48.mission_1.name: Outlaw Treasure
questlog.quest_48.name: The Outlaw Camp
questlog.quest_49.mission_1.name: Haut et sec
questlog.quest_49.mission_1.state_1: Dedoras asked for you to talk to Charles, he knows about a small island.
questlog.quest_49.mission_1.state_2: You got stucked on this island. You must discover how to leave.
questlog.quest_49.mission_1.state_3: You successfully built a raft and used the starts to navigate your way through the waves. At least you found something of interest on the deserted island.
questlog.quest_49.mission_2.name: Liquid Death
questlog.quest_49.mission_2.state_1: Dedoras has sent you to Spectulus in the Edron Academy. Rumors of strange fishmen in the Tiquanda region may be connected to some of the research the scholar conducted.
questlog.quest_49.mission_2.state_2: Spectulus asked you to check out the rumors of strange fishmen in the jungles of northern Tiquanda. A small sunken temple is said to be overrun by strange fish-like creatures.
questlog.quest_49.mission_2.state_3: You found a sunken temple deep in the Tiquanda jungle. Spectulus will help you enter the vortex at the entrance. Find out what happened there and take care of the fish-like aggressors...
questlog.quest_49.mission_2.state_7: Brokul has been defeated and now you can talk with Spectulus or Dedoras what you found about the fishmen.
questlog.quest_49.mission_3.name: Asuri - The Lament
questlog.quest_49.mission_3.state_1: Go to Asuri Palace in Port Hope.
questlog.quest_49.mission_3.state_2: You were able to assemble an instrument with the objects found. That should work for something.
questlog.quest_49.mission_3.state_3: You must talk with the dead girl's mother, Gail, at Port Hope.
questlog.quest_49.mission_3.state_4: With a heavy heart you used a piece of ebony as well as the skull and hair of an unfortunate maiden to create a bone fiddle. By playing the Peacock Ballad you should be able to open the viollet portal.
questlog.quest_49.mission_3.state_5: You may enter the viollet portal. Check if there is something useful there.
questlog.quest_49.mission_3.state_6: In a secret room of the Asura Palace you discovered an old writing desk that contains an ancient map. This must be a hint to the secret library you are searching for.
questlog.quest_49.mission_4.name: The Order of the Falcon
questlog.quest_49.mission_4.state_1: It is said that an ancient order of knights once resided in Edron. The knights disappeared a long time ago but their abandoned outpost is still there. The place may yet hold some surprises.
questlog.quest_49.mission_4.state_2: You defeated Grand Master Oberon in mortal combat. The Falcon Order may have lost its glory a long time ago but you are just getting started.
questlog.quest_49.mission_5.name: The Path of Defiances
questlog.quest_49.mission_5.state_1: Go to Darashia and find out about the mysterious statue.
questlog.quest_49.mission_5.state_2: After you have been swallowed by a sand vortex you have entered a hidden desert area. A voice of unknown origin has informed you that you will have to face some challenges.
questlog.quest_49.mission_5.state_8: You have found a book page in a chest. It seems to contain very useful information, but you are not capable to read it. At this point you have to speak with an expert.
questlog.quest_49.mission_6.name: Bursting at the Seams
questlog.quest_49.mission_6.state_1: Dedoras told you where to search for leads to the Veiled Hoard: the museum in Thais, a fishmen temple in Tiquanda, an order fortress in Edron, the Asuri Palace and a deserted isle.
questlog.quest_49.mission_6.state_2: You talked with Gareth and now you may pass trougth the door.
questlog.quest_49.mission_6.state_6: You successfully entered the Veiled Hoard of Zathroth. However, countless secret and vast knowledge still lie ahead.
questlog.quest_49.mission_6.state_7: You have reported Gareth about the enigmatic inscription you have found in the chamber of doom. He was able to decipher it for you and referred to Dedoras in Cormaya for further assistance.
questlog.quest_49.name: The Secret Library

questlog.quest_5.mission_21.name: Gnomish War Hero (Warzone 2)
questlog.quest_5.mission_21.state_1: Deliver the Gnomevil's hat to gnomission to enter the second warzone for free.

questlog.quest_5.mission_22.name: Gnomish War Hero (Warzone 3)
questlog.quest_5.mission_22.state_1: Deliver the Abyssador's lash to gnomission to enter the third warzone for free.
questlog.quest_5.mission_22.state_2: You may enter the third warzone without using a mission crystal.
questlog.quest_5.mission_3.name: Recruitment: A Test in Gnomology
questlog.quest_5.mission_3.state_5: Pass Gnomerik's test by answering his questions. If you fail to get a high enough score drink a mushroom beer and start again.
questlog.quest_5.mission_3.state_6: You have passed the gnomish psychology test and can proceed to the medical exam. Talk to Gnomespector about your next examination.
questlog.quest_5.mission_4.description: Walk through the g-ray apparatus for your g-raying.
questlog.quest_5.mission_4.name: Recruitment: Medical Examination
questlog.quest_5.mission_5.name: Recruitment: Ear Examination
questlog.quest_5.mission_5.state_10: You have been g-rayed. It has been an ... unexpected experience. Now you are ready for your ear examination. Walk up to doctor Gnomedix and wait for him to finish your ear examination.
questlog.quest_5.mission_5.state_11: You passed the ear examination. Well, at least most of you did. Now talk to Gnomaticus about your next test.
questlog.quest_5.mission_6.description_d: Hit five targets in a row. Don't hit an innocent target as it will reset your hit counter. %d / 5
questlog.quest_5.mission_6.name: Recruitment: Gnomish Warfare
questlog.quest_5.mission_7.description: You are now ready for your endurance test. Talk to Gnomewart about it.

questlog.quest_5.mission_8.state_17: Enter the lower chamber for your endurance test. Reach the teleporter north of the hall.
questlog.quest_5.mission_8.state_18: You have passed the endurance test. Report back to Gnomewart.
questlog.quest_5.mission_8.state_19: You passed the endurance test and are ready to talk to Gnomelvis about your soul melody.
questlog.quest_5.mission_9.name: Recruitment: Soul Melody
questlog.quest_5.mission_9.state_21: Find your personal soul melody by trial and error. Create the complete soul melody of seven notes and then report to Gnomelvis. Red notes indicate a failure.
questlog.quest_5.mission_9.state_22: You found your very own soul melody. You should talk to Gnomelvis about it!
