questlog.quest_50.mission_1.name: The Dream Courts
questlog.quest_50.mission_1.state_2: You must kill the Nightmare Beast.
questlog.quest_50.mission_1.state_3: By defeating the dreadful Nightmare Beast you did the Winter Court and the Summer Court alike a great favor. From now on, the dream elves will regard you as a friend.
questlog.quest_50.mission_2.name: Unsafe Release
questlog.quest_50.mission_2.state_3: Andre was happy to hear that the compass works as intendend. From now on it is possible that he will charge your compass again. It can be used to give acess to mystical chests once a day.
questlog.quest_50.mission_3.name: Treeling Maison
questlog.quest_50.mission_3.state_6: Activating the ward stone after defeating the Faceless Bane has gained you acess to the deepest mysteries of the dream courts.
questlog.quest_50.mission_4.name: The Seven Keys
questlog.quest_50.mission_4.state_2: You found the seven keys to unlock the Seven Dream Doors in the Labyrinth of Summer's and Winter's Dreams.
questlog.quest_50.name: The Dream Courts
questlog.quest_6.mission_1.name: Prove Your Worzz!
questlog.quest_6.mission_1.state_1: Your Mission is to go to a little camp of lizards at north-east of the Dragonblaze Peaks. You have to find and deliver the Tactical map complete the mission.
questlog.quest_6.mission_1.state_2: You delivered the Tactical map to Zalamon.
questlog.quest_6.mission_2.name: Mission 1: Corruption
questlog.quest_6.mission_2.state_1: Go to the Temple of Equilibrium (it's marked on your map) and find out what happened there.
questlog.quest_6.mission_2.state_2: The temple has been corrupted and is lost. Zalamon should be informed about this as soon as possible.
questlog.quest_6.mission_2.state_3: You already reported Zalamon about the Temple! Ask him for new mission!
questlog.quest_6.mission_3.name: Mission 2: Imperial Zzecret Weaponzz
questlog.quest_6.mission_3.state_1: Go into the small camp Chaochai to the north of the Dragonblaze Peaks (Zalamon marks the entrance on your map). There are 3 buildings which you have to spy
questlog.quest_6.mission_3.state_2: You spied 1 of 3 buildings of the camp.
questlog.quest_6.mission_3.state_3: You spied 2 of 3 buildings of the camp.
questlog.quest_6.mission_3.state_4: You spied 3 of 3 buildings of the camp. Zalamon should be informed about this as soon as possible.
questlog.quest_6.mission_3.state_5: You already reported Zalamon about the camp! Ask him for new mission!
questlog.quest_6.mission_4.name: Mission 3: Zee Killing Fieldzz
questlog.quest_6.mission_4.state_1: Get the poison from Zalamon's storage room. Then go to the teleporter to the Muggy Plains and head east from there to the rice fields. Go to the very top rice field and use the poison anywhere on the water.
questlog.quest_6.mission_4.state_2: Le riz a été empoisonné. Cela affaiblira considérablement l’armée de l’Empereur. Revenez et parlez à Zalamon de votre réussite.
questlog.quest_6.mission_4.state_3: You already reported Zalamon about your success! Ask him for new mission!
questlog.quest_6.mission_5.name: Mission 4: Zze Way of Zztonezz
questlog.quest_6.mission_5.state_1: Your mission is to find a way to enter the north of the valley and find a passage to the great gate itself. Search any temples or settlements you come across for hidden passages.
questlog.quest_6.mission_5.state_2: Report Zalamon about the strange symbols that you found.
questlog.quest_6.mission_5.state_3: Get the greasy oil from Zalamon's storage room and put them on the levers that you found.
questlog.quest_6.mission_5.state_4: En raison de leur caractère très gras, les feuilles de départ peuvent désormais être déplacées.
questlog.quest_6.mission_5.state_5: You found the right combination for the puzzle in the mountains and triggered some kind of mechanism. You should head back to Zalamon to report your success.
questlog.quest_6.mission_5.state_6: You already reported Zalamon about your success! You got a Tome of Knowledge as reward! Ask him for new mission!
questlog.quest_6.mission_6.name: Mission 5: Phantom Army
questlog.quest_6.mission_6.state_1: Zalamon has sent you on a quest to find out what lies beneath the secret portal in the temple. Find it and explore the other side.
questlog.quest_6.mission_6.state_2: Eternal guardians and lizard chosen has been awaken. Survive them and report it to Zalamon!
questlog.quest_6.mission_6.state_3: You Survived the Waves and reported Zalamon about your success! You got a Serpent Crest as reward!
questlog.quest_6.name: Children of the Revolution
questlog.quest_7.mission_1.name: The Marid and the Efreet - Djinn Greeting
questlog.quest_7.mission_1.state_1: Melchior told you the word "Djanni'hah" which can be used to talk to Djinns. Be aware that once you become an ally of one Djinn race, you cannot switch sides anymore.
questlog.quest_7.mission_2.name: The Marid and the Efreet - Marid Faction
questlog.quest_7.mission_2.state_1: You have joined the Marid. These friendly, blue Djinns are honest and fair allies. You have pledged eternal loyalty to King Gabel and may enter Asha'daramai freely. Djanni'hah!
questlog.quest_7.mission_3.name: The Efreet and the Efreet - Efreet Faction
questlog.quest_7.mission_3.state_1: You have joined the Efreet. These evil, green Djinns are always up to mischievous pranks. You have pledged eternal loyalty to King Malor and may enter Mal'ouquah freely. Djanni'hah!
questlog.quest_7.name: Factions
questlog.quest_8.mission_1.name: The Sweaty Cyclops
questlog.quest_8.mission_1.state_1: Big Ben, the cyclops in Ab'Dendriel sends you to bring him 3 bast skirts for his woman. After this he will help you to forge different steel.
questlog.quest_8.mission_1.state_2: Big Ben, the cyclops in Ab'Dendriel will help you to forge different steel now. Just ask him if you need something.
questlog.quest_8.mission_2.name: The Mermaid Marina
questlog.quest_8.mission_2.state_1: Marina, the mermaid north of Sabrehaven sends you to bring her 50 honeycombs. After this she will help you create spool of yarn.
questlog.quest_8.mission_2.state_2: Marina, the mermaid north of Sabrehaven will help you to create a spool of yarn from 10 pieces of spider silk. Just ask her if you need something.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.name: The Blessed Stake
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_1: Quentin told you about an old prayer which can bind holy energy to an object. Each of its ten lines has to be recited by a different priest though. Bring Quentin a wooden stake from Gamon to start.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_10: You received Brewster's prayer: "Your hand shall be guided - your feet shall walk in harmony". Now, bring your stake to Tyrias in Liberty Bay for the next line of the prayer.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_11: You received Tyrias' prayer: "Your mind shall be a vessel for joy, light and wisdom". He wasn't exactly happy though and said that if you need some mumbo jumbo again, you should rather go to Chondur.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_12: Chondur was surprised to hear that you had to travel through all of Tibia to have your wooden stake blessed. He offered you help with the blessing if you should need one again in the future.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_2: You received Quentin's prayer: "Light shall be near - and darkness afar". Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_3: You received Tibra's prayer: "Hope may fill your heart - doubt shall be banned". Now, bring your stake to Maealil in the Elven settlement for the next line of the prayer.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_4: You received Maealil's prayer: "Peace may fill your soul - evil shall be cleansed". Now, bring your stake to Yberius in the Venore temple for the next line of the prayer.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_5: You received Yberius' prayer: "Protection will be granted - from dangers at hand". Now, bring your stake to Isimov in the dwarven settlement for the next line of the prayer.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_6: You received Isimov's prayer: "Unclean spirits shall be repelled". Now, bring your stake to Amanda in Edron for the next line of the prayer.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_7: You received Amanda's prayer: "Wicked curses shall be broken". Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_8: You received Kasmir's prayer: "Let there be honor and humility". Now, bring your stake to Rahkem in Ankrahmun for the next line of the prayer.
questlog.quest_8.mission_3.state_9: You received Rahkem's prayer: "Let there be power and compassion". Now, bring your stake to Brewster in Port Hope for the next line of the prayer.
questlog.quest_8.name: Friends and Traders
questlog.quest_9.mission_1.name: Hot Cuisine
questlog.quest_9.mission_1.state_1: You've become the apprentice of Maltre Jean Pierre. The first dish he will teach you to prepare is Rotworm Stew. Bring him the ingredients he told you.
questlog.quest_9.mission_1.state_10: You have completed the ninth dish, the tenth dish he will teach you to prepare is Carrot Cake. Bring him the ingredients he told you.
questlog.quest_9.mission_1.state_11: You have completed the tenth dish. You are now able to obtain the cookbook from Jean Pierre's room upstairs.
